records.name: Synter Canvas
records.tagline: Your AI agent runs ads across 30+ ad platforms
records.description: Your AI agent builds, launches and optimizes campaigns across 30+ ad platforms, with safety gates and guardrails on every change. $0.25 per verified write, 0% of ad spend.

records.name: kwant
records.tagline: AI bots that check each other's work before saying "done"
records.description: Open-source AI team for your Mac, Linux or VPS. Hire bots from 27 roles; each message goes to the bot that fits, and you see why. Bots split work into cards, hand off and test each other, and a task turns Verified only when kwant checks it. Web facts come with links that open at the exact quote. Bots earn autonomy in Flight School, but payments always ask, and you choose which sites each bot may open. Runs on the Claude, Codex or Grok you already pay for.

records.name: Teamily AI
records.tagline: Your personal agent, agent teams & people in one messenger
records.description: The human-agent platform where people and always-on agents get work done together in one unified, context-aware space. Unlike single-user personal agents, Teamily AI enables multi-user, multi-agent teamwork. Built on an AI-native messenger, it connects people, agents, docs, meetings, calls, workflows, and business systems to automate office work and customer service. Agents become real teammates with persistent memory, proactive intelligence, and continuous self-improvement. Free to get started.

records.name: Infino AI
records.tagline: Search, vectors and SQL over one Parquet copy, for agents
records.description: Infino is an open-source retrieval engine for AI agents. It keeps one copy of your data as Parquet on S3 or local disk, with BM25 and vector indexes inside the files. Agents run keyword, vector, hybrid and SQL search on it. Apache-2.0. Infino Cloud is generally available, with a free tier.

records.name: nana
records.tagline: One terminal for every coding agent, on Windows
records.description: Nana is a native terminal multiplexer for Windows. Run Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and more side by side, each on its own git worktree. See who is working, waiting or done, review diffs, and keep agents running after you close the app. Free beta.

records.name: MagicaLCore
records.tagline: Six kinds of machine learning models, trained on your iPad
records.description: MagicaLCore 2.0 goes from one model type to six: image, sound, tabular data, text, hand pose and hand action. Everything trains on the iPad's own chip, with no code, no Mac and no cloud. New in 2.0: pause a training and resume it later from History, test your model live with the camera or microphone, and a short explanation next to every setting. Export a standardmlmodel and drop it into Swift Playgrounds or Xcode. In 13 languages, plus an edition for schools.

records.name: One Roof
records.tagline: A new way to build with agents. You stay in charge.
records.description: One place for chorus coding: several sessions of Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Kimi and Antigravity working together, with you in charge. Real terminals, one Inbox for everything they ask you, and a morning page that says what happened overnight. Free and open source.

records.name: IQ
records.tagline: The dashboard for your team's AI use
records.description: See usage, spend and every request in one place. Give each app or teammate its own key and limits. On Team, add budgets, alerts and an audit log. Built-in routing helps keep cost down. Plus IQ Code, our plugin for Claude Code. Free to start.

records.name: Akema
records.tagline: Read-only Kafka message inspection & analytics
records.description: Watch the bus. Read-only Kafka message inspection and analytics: browse live topics, trap messages with CEL expressions and chart a window of traffic with DuckDB in the browser, without storing topic data. The stream, observed.

records.name: AgentKit by Scalekit
records.tagline: MCP gateway for production agents that acts on your behalf
records.description: Let your agents use 30,000+ tools across 600+ apps, from Salesforce to GitHub, through one MCP gateway. AgentKit handles auth and integrations, so every action runs as the user who asked, within the scopes they granted. Give each agent only the tools its job needs with Virtual MCP Servers. Add internal APIs as custom connectors. Use Triggers to start an agent the moment an email lands. Built for developers taking agents to production: every call is logged. Free tier: 10,000 tool calls a month.

records.name: People Search by Context.dev
records.tagline: People Search API: Find People by Role, Company & Location
records.description: Describe the people you need in plain English. Get up to 10 profiles per call with role, employer, location, experience, skills, and schools.

records.name: MachineMail
records.tagline: Real inboxes for AI agents, with trust built in
records.description: Give your AI agents real inboxes to receive and send emails. Connect them over MCP or API, use your own domain, and get a trust report on every inbound message. Free includes 3,000 messages/month; paid plans start at $9/month.

records.name: Testera
records.tagline: AI-driven API testing
records.description: Free test management with hosted MCP for any AI client — Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, VS Code, or your own agents. Agentic Test Management on Advanced: triage CI failures, draft-PR self-heal, automations, and webhooks.

records.name: Hookdeck Inspect
records.tagline: Free webhook tester for you and your agent
records.description: Test and debug webhooks with Hookdeck Inspect. Get a live URL you and your agent can use, plus mock webhooks for 500+ providers. It's free, no account or setup required.

records.name: Flockbay
records.tagline: Free AI game maker built on Godot
records.description: Flockbay is a free AI game maker built on Godot: an agent in the official Godot editor that writes GDScript and scenes, then playtests them. It runs the game, sends input events, reads the debugger and captures the viewport. Your game stays a plain Godot 4 project on disk. Start on free hosted AI, or bring your own Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, API key or MCP agent, or a local model on your GPU (Windows). Paid plans add Steam page drafts, trailers and devlogs. Godot 4.6+ on Windows, macOS, Linux.

records.name: Wavefunction
records.tagline: A minimal, open-source coding agent for your Mac
records.description: Coding agents keep turning into super apps. Wavefunction goes the other way: a minimal desktop app built for coding. Keep chatting while it works on several tasks in parallel. Use your ChatGPT subscription, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter or a local model. Computer use runs on its own desktop, not yours. Free and open source.

records.name: asklog
records.tagline: Give your coding agents a boss. Answer it from your phone.
records.description: Tell Chief one job. It splits it into tasks and starts Claude Code or Codex workers, each in its own copy of your repo, then brings you the decisions. Watch and answer from your phone, across your computers. Nothing merges without your authorization.

records.name: LifeVal
records.tagline: OpenAI's benchmark for everyday life tasks with AI
records.description: LifeVal is OpenAI's new eval for the everyday tasks people most want help with, like finding childcare, budgeting, ordering groceries and government services. OpenAI says it used LifeVal for a year to push ChatGPT toward real agent work.

records.name: Scrawl
records.tagline: Show your AI agent the problem with a visual frame
records.description: Scrawl records your screen, voice, clicks and drawings, then packs them into one compact capture you paste into your AI coding agent. Press ⌥⇧S, talk, click and draw. Frames are taken only when something happens, speech is transcribed on your Mac, and each frame is cropped to where you worked. Works with iPhone mirroring and ScrawlKit for iOS apps. Open source (MIT). macOS 15+, Apple silicon.

records.name: Beaquaro Studio
records.tagline: Write once, post everywhere. Your link in bio, too.
records.description: Write in your own voice, post to your platforms, reply to comments, and share one link page with your portfolio, projects and bookable video calls. Free to start. Built by one person in the UK for creators who are tired of ten tabs.

records.name: Beamfy
records.tagline: AI vision assistant for blind people, live in 74 languages
records.description: Beamfy is an AI vision assistant for blind and low-vision people. Tap once and it describes what is in front of you as you walk, speaking only what changes, hazards first, until you stop it. It reads printed text aloud, tells you what you are holding, finds a place by voice with walking directions, and SOS texts your emergency contact with your location. Built for VoiceOver and TalkBack, in 74 languages. Photos are not stored. Free to start on iPhone and Android.

records.name: SUN Web & API
records.tagline: Turn prompts and PDFs into audio, on the web or via API
records.description: Meet the new SUN web experience and SUN API. Turn a prompt or PDF into podcasts, audio courses, audiobooks, stories, meditations, or music. Choose your voices, language, and length, explore public audio, and build audio generation into your own apps with the API.

records.name: Peji
records.tagline: An AI chat with a real browser you control
records.description: The browser on your iPhone finishes the task. Ask for a price comparison, a flight, a PDF summary: Peji opens WebKit tabs, reads them, clicks and types, and keeps going until the job is done, with every step in the chat. It stops and waits for your tap before it sends, buys, pays or deletes. Chats, files and dictation stay on the phone. Answers that are a price list or a schedule come back as a table or a chart with the source links. Free on the App Store; Pro adds usage.

records.name: NEXUPIRA
records.tagline: AI teammates that hand back finished work
records.description: Hire an AI team, not another chat box. Every WhatsApp customer message gets a reply drafted from your own documents, Rex prepares quotes as PDFs, Docu turns receipts and statements into Excel, and Nova keeps your calendar. Set routines that run on schedule. Connect Google Workspace and Notion free; Slack, GitHub and Linear on Pro. Work with your AI team from ChatGPT or Claude (Pro). You approve what goes out. Free to start, Pro US$15/mo.

records.name: Oreja de Van Gogh
records.tagline: pause Apple Music while ChatGPT speaks
records.description: A macOS menu bar app that pauses or lowers Apple Music while ChatGPT speaks, then returns it at the level and position you chose.

records.name: Prism
records.tagline: Cursor for hardware engineering
records.description: Prism is the AI platform for hardware engineering. CAD, physics solvers, 3D viewers, coding, and reporting together in one place, all driven by agents. Go from ideas to validated design effortlessly. Free to try on Windows, Mac and Linux.

records.name: EaseIn Health
records.tagline: Track GLP-1 doses, symptoms and daily habits in one app
records.description: Most GLP-1 apps stop at the dose. The hard part is everything in between: getting enough protein and water, handling nausea, keeping a routine. EaseIn tracks the whole journey & not just the injection: - Dose log with injection site rotation - Symptom log for nausea, fatigue & more - One daily card for protein, water, fibre, activity & sleep - Weekly Wrapped, a recap of your week - Dedicated Health coach for questions between appointments

records.name: Corvo
records.tagline: A mailbox that tidies itself as mail arrives
records.description: A new mailbox, not a layer over Gmail. Sign-in codes sit on the row with Copy, then archive themselves. Give each site its own address and pause it if it leaks. Trackers removed, scams called out. Agents draft under grants; nothing leaves without you.

records.name: Remote Gaze
records.tagline: Your Mac on your iPad and iPhone with no in-between server
records.description: Remote Gaze puts your whole Mac on your iPad or iPhone at Retina resolution, up to 120fps, with touch, trackpad, keyboard and Apple Pencil. Nothing passes through anyone else's server: devices connect directly, end to end encrypted, with per-device keys in the Secure Enclave and Face ID gating. Gaze Host, the free Mac companion, gives a headless Mac mini a display of its own.

records.name: LidCommit
records.tagline: Auto-commit when you close your laptop lid
records.description: Never lose progress when you leave your desk. LidCommit is an autonomous Rust daemon with a sleek dark-mode desktop GUI that detects when your laptop lid closes, summarizes your diffs using Gemini, Ollama, or OpenAI, and pushes safely to GitHub with built-in secret scanning.

records.name: Calendarly
records.tagline: Your calendar and tasks, right on your iPhone Lock Screen
records.description: Calendarly draws your calendar, reminders, Todoist tasks, notes and countdowns onto the iPhone Lock Screen wallpaper, and redraws it automatically through a Shortcuts automation.

records.name: Testifly
records.tagline: Autonomous AI QA. Zero prompting. Zero maintenance.
records.description: CTOs and founders with small teams and no time or resources to test and maintain. Connect your web app and Testifly does the rest. Discovers flows, writes tests, self-heals, explains failures with video. Zero prompting. Zero maintenance. 30-day free trial.

records.name: VinSage
records.tagline: Free used-car check in Chrome's side panel, US & CA
records.description: VinSage sits beside any used-car listing in Chrome and shows NHTSA and Transport Canada recalls, crash ratings, owner complaints, fuel cost and a 0–100 deal score, plus a negotiation pack. Core checks are free. No account, no ads, no analytics.

records.name: Videco
records.tagline: Turn every video into a content campaign with AI
records.description: Videco is an AI content studio and video hosting workspace for marketing teams. Find standout moments in demos and webinars, create branded short-form clips, and host, embed, and measure video in one place.

records.name: HoldTalk
records.tagline: Hold fn, speak, and the text appears in any Mac app
records.description: HoldTalk is dictation for the Mac without a subscription. Hold the fn key, speak, and the text appears at the cursor in any app. Transcription runs on your Mac with Apple's speech engine, with a personal dictionary and a searchable history. 7 days of Pro free, then 2,000 free words a week or Pro once for 19 EUR during the launch.

records.name: BRCKS Chat
records.tagline: The chat app for building sites. Nothing gets lost.
records.description: Every job gets its own chat for crews, subs and clients, with snags, bookings, video meetings and a client portal built in. Photos become snags, messages become a record. Subs and clients are free. Built by builders, for UK sites.

records.name: Brink
records.tagline: Turn your MacBook trackpad's edges into controls
records.description: Brink is a free macOS menu bar app that turns your trackpad's edges into controls. Slide the right edge for volume, the left for brightness, the top for keyboard light. Swipe the bottom to skip, double-tap the corner to mute. Native HUD, haptic ticks.

records.name: PowerShips
records.tagline: Where battleships meets powers!
records.description: Battleships with classes. Pick a class with an active ability and a passive, place your fleet and play a friend from a link or find an opponent online. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: Photo Reel
records.tagline: Turn three photos into a 10-second vertical clip.
records.description: Photo Reel turns three photos into one 1080x1920 clip: 10 seconds, a slow push-in, three hard cuts, your title, an optional price tag. Each photo is fitted whole - whatever doesn't fill the frame gets a blurred copy of the same photo, not black bars. It runs on your machine: no account, nothing uploaded, no watermark. It is not an editor: no captions, no music, no timeline, no audio track. Python 3 required. $29 one-time. Done-for-you: send three photos, get the clip back.

records.name: Star-Spangled Tycoon
records.tagline: A parody idle tycoon for a break from the news
records.description: Build a ridiculous parody political empire, from a flag stand on Earth to the Multiverse. Hire a Cabinet of cartoon presidents, travel five worlds and watch the money roll in, even offline. Free on iPhone and iPad, no endorsement implied, no actual politics.

records.name: Uniform maker
records.tagline: AFC Wimbledon    Accrington    Aldershot    Arsenal    Aston
records.description: Soccer uniform This is the standard fabric moisture-or professional and most amateur soccer kits. It is lightweight, durable, winking (pulls sweat away from the body), quick-drying, breathable (especially in mesh or micro-pique weaves), and holds colors well don't hesitate to reach out via Here's my WhatsApp for easier communication +923336191927

records.name: Words with Mia
records.tagline: Word search made for 22 languages, not translated into them
records.description: Words with Mia was built one language at a time: 22 languages so far, each with its own 2,500-level Word Path and a daily puzzle on local themes, with the words people actually use and the days they actually celebrate. Next to classic word search there are boards with a twist, like frozen letters, secret codes and honeycombs. Playing in a language you're learning? Every word comes with its meaning in your own language. More languages are on the way.

records.name: Hubgram
records.tagline: Telegram Message Scheduling & Group Management
records.description: Schedule recurring Telegram messages, manage accounts, find groups and channels, and track delivery results. Free web plan: 1 account, 3 saved messages, 5 destinations and 30 daily attempts. Android and Windows apps require Pro or Unlimited. Telegram limits apply.

records.name: attested
records.tagline: Swap test screenshots for signed receipts on pull requests
records.description: Your tests already record proof. attested keeps it in your CI and gives the pull request a signed receipt instead: the result on this exact commit, every file fingerprinted, and a required check can block the merge without one. Free and open source.

records.name: Speech to Text Free
records.tagline: Turn voice messages, audio and video into text in Telegram
records.description: A free Telegram bot that transcribes speech. Forward a voice message or video note, send an audio or video file (up to 20 MB), or paste a YouTube, TikTok or Instagram link (up to 3 hours), and get the text back in the chat. The speech language is detected automatically. Separate bots for English (@SpeechToTextFreeBot), Spanish (@TranscribirGratisBot), Portuguese (@TranscreverGratisBot) and Russian (@GolosovoeVTekstBot).

records.name: Sudex
records.tagline: Court books built and checked on your own computer
records.description: Putting a court book together by hand eats whole evenings. Sudex builds one from a folder of documents: cover, index, dividers, page numbers and links. Then it opens the finished PDF and checks every page, bookmark and link. Late document? It goes in as 45A and nobody's references move. Word files, emails, spreadsheets and photos become PDFs on the way in, and there are templates for 60+ courts worldwide. It runs offline on your own Windows PC, so nothing gets uploaded. Free for 30 days.

records.name: ASCII Art Generator
records.tagline: Turn images into ASCII art on the web and in Figma
records.description: Turn photos and logos into ASCII art in your browser or Figma. Tune character sets, detail, brightness, contrast, dithering and edge effects, then copy text or export TXT, PNG and text-based SVG. The web studio processes images on your device, includes free tools without signup and shares eligible ASCII Art Generator licenses with the Figma plugin. Explore prepared examples before unlocking Pro effects.

records.name: Soaptoday
records.tagline: Exploring Online Movies, TV Series, Easy Content Discovery
records.description: Website usability plays an important role in visitor satisfaction. Even a website with numerous entertainment categories can become frustrating if users struggle to locate its features. Soap2Day HD presents a search option and genre-based navigation to help visitors explore its available listings. A straightforward layout can reduce unnecessary browsing and make it easier to find particular movie or television titles.

records.name: Swizzle
records.tagline: Self-hosted runtime for automations your AI agent writes
records.description: Swizzle is an open-source runtime for automations that your coding agent writes as plain Python, JavaScript or TypeScript. You describe the job, the agent writes the code once, and Swizzle runs it on your own server with schedules, webhooks, OAuth, encrypted secrets, retries, approvals and step-by-step logs. Give your agent the repo and it sets Swizzle up for you. Free under Apache 2.0.

records.name: Take Your Business to the Next Level
records.tagline: Best digital marketing agency in chennai
records.description: Looking for the best digital marketing agency in Chennai to grow your business online? Discover effective SEO, social media marketing, paid advertising, content marketing, and other digital solutions designed to improve your online presence.Explore your digital marketing options today.

records.name: Nedeo Live Chat & Lead Capture
records.tagline: Managed AI chat that answers questions and captures leads
records.description: Nedeo Live Chat & Lead Capture gives local businesses a managed website chat that answers visitor questions and collects enquiries. Nedeo Studio configures the chat for each business using its services and information, then keeps it updated. Visitors can ask questions around the clock, including in multiple languages. Plans start at A$40/month. Explore the live demo and request setup at nedeo.io.

records.name: Oddments
records.tagline: Free, open-source reference library for designers and 3D
records.description: Oddments keeps your references in a folder on your disk: pictures, video, fonts, PDFs, 3D models and materials. Paste with Ctrl+V, search by meaning or colour with AI that runs locally, and send models to Blender. Free and MIT-licensed, for Windows and Mac.

records.name: VoiceBrief
records.tagline: Turn Telegram voice notes and text into 1–3 key points
records.description: Forward a Telegram voice note, audio file or text messages to VoiceBrief and get 1–3 key points. Voice trials and paid audio inputs can return labelled AI audio in the speaker’s voice with their permission; text inputs return text. English interface; summaries stay in the source language. Three eligible voice trials and one daily free text summary are available, with additional use through Telegram Stars passes.

records.name: PromptDock AI
records.tagline: Platform to Discover, Publish and Earn with AI Knowledge
records.description: A platform where anyone can discover, share, and use AI prompts and agent skills. Creators can build their profiles and earn from views and skill installs. With PromptDock MCP, you can also bring knowledge from creators worldwide into your favorite AI assistant. Think of it as YouTube for AI Prompts & Agent Skills!

records.name: FlightShield®
records.tagline: A global pre-flight risk briefing platform for GA pilots
records.description: FlightShield gives general aviation pilots an objective, second pair of eyes risk briefing in under 60 seconds. By stress-testing personal minimums and aircraft POH limits against live METARs/TAFs, runway slopes, wet grass penalties, and official AAIB/NTSB accident intelligence, it flags hidden threats like sun glare on final, icing risks, and performance traps so pilots make confident go/no-go decisions. Safety-critical functions use deterministic mathematical formulae, not generative AI.

records.name: Matthew Slack Business Excellence Hub
records.tagline: Strategic leadership for sustainable business growth
records.description: Employees play an essential role in organisational success. A people-first leadership philosophy encourages open communication, collaboration, accountability, and professional development. When employees understand business objectives and feel supported in their roles, they can contribute more effectively to shared goals.

records.name: Kin & Kettle
records.tagline: A private family cookbook you cook from and print
records.description: Kin & Kettle keeps a family's recipes in one place. Everyone adds the dishes they make, cooks one step at a time, and prints full size or recipe cards with a QR code. Works on phones, tablets and computers, nothing to install. The Starter plan is free to keep. It's not a trial, and there's nothing to cancel.

records.name: Wholesale All in one
records.tagline: Sell wholesale and retail from one Shopify store
records.description: Wholesale All In One is a complete suite with robust features that help you manage your B2B wholesale and direct-to-consumer businesses in one store. Set B2B wholesale pricing, custom pricing, discounts and volume pricing by collection, product, variant, market and customer. Fast ordering with B2B registration, quick order forms and net terms. Offers Order Limits, MOQ, Manage Lock, Login to View Price, VAT, shipping, tax exemptions, manual orders, extra fees, POS and bulk import, all in one app.

records.name: Questant
records.tagline: Real-world lessons, learning games and AI films for kids
records.description: Questant turns curious questions into learning for kids, families and teachers. Explore real-world science stories in English, practise vocabulary and reasoning, and explain ideas in your own words. Play maths battles, teach a character what you know, or turn a what-if question into a film with Ria Spark. Start with a free lesson; paid plans unlock more, and film generation uses credits.

records.name: O Comandante
records.tagline: Watch any real flight live in photorealistic 3D
records.description: Pick any real flight in the sky and watch it in photorealistic 3D: cockpit, chase or tower camera, with live weather, real terrain and buildings. Find it in plain words, like "from guarulhos to miami", and get every flight with its departure time. Scrub the timeline to replay takeoffs and landings. No install, no plugin, works on your phone. Born from following one small plane, the Brasileirinho, around the world.

records.name: Sanctions checks in Slack & HubSpot
records.tagline: Daily sanctions screening where your team already works
records.description: Fines for dealing with sanctioned parties are high, and your company pays them. Unicorn Intelligence checks company and person names against official lists (OFAC SDN, EU, UN, UK, US CSL, UFLPA) every day, with traffic light, list, similarity, source and date. New: Slack command /intelligence, a Sanctions check card in HubSpot, a Zapier app, and one-click import from Google Sheets for a free risk map of your customer list. $50 credit gift at sign up.

records.name: RoomFit
records.tagline: Compare room layouts before moving your furniture
records.description: RoomFit is a free browser-based 2D planner for testing furniture arrangements on your phone or computer. Edit room shapes and measurements, move furniture and carpets, rotate pieces one degree at a time, and export a PNG. Try the furnished practice room without changing your saved plan.

records.name: AS2AI – Universe Explorer
records.tagline: Explore the real night sky, stars, and planets
records.description: AS2AI makes astronomy easier to explore. Discover real stars, planets, constellations, and celestial objects through an interactive sky experience. Plan your night with observing suggestions based on your location and explore the universe with scientific data.

records.name: Braille Converter & Learning Tool
records.tagline: Text to braille and back, plus a practice quiz. Free
records.description: Convert English text to Grade 1 braille, or braille back to text, in real time. Each character appears as a clear 6-dot cell, with capital and number signs added automatically. Type braille with the on-screen braille keyboard, then copy or print your result. It’s built for learning too: an alphabet and reference chart shows every letter, and a practice quiz tracks your score and accuracy. It also has dark mode. Great for students, teachers, families and the curious. No signup.

records.name: NOAA Weather Radar Live
records.tagline: Track live storm radar, rain forecasts & severe weather
records.description: Stay ahead of severe weather with NOAA Weather Radar Live – your all-in-one Doppler radar and hurricane tracker. Get real-time precipitation maps, live storm paths, and minute-by-minute rain nowcasting directly on high-res interactive maps. Features include 24h–72h timeline scrubbers, severe storm alerts, hyperlocal 14-day forecasts, and sleek home screen widgets. Download NOAA Weather Radar Live today to stay prepared and never get caught off guard!

records.name: Deckumi
records.tagline: Turn notes into flashcards you can check, edit, and review
records.description: Bring a PDF or notes, generate flashcards, check source references, and edit the wording before studying. Rate your recall and let FSRS schedule the next review. Import existing decks, or explore the free examples first. Launch gift: 50 single-use codes for 30 days of Plus + 50 credits in the pinned maker comment. Flashcards are available now.

records.name: Backuparr
records.tagline: Self-hosted backups for your *arr stack and media servers
records.description: Backuparr backs up Radarr, Sonarr, Plex, Jellyfin and 12 more self-hosted apps on a schedule, sends the backups to local storage, Google Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox, and restores them from a web UI.

records.name: Declare
records.tagline: Share your focus with people who matter
records.description: Declare App We've added some new features! A focus app for students who want to stay committed. 1. Get a 5-second distraction alert when you switch to another app while studying or reading. 2. Make a commitment and share your study or fitness activities in real time with close friends through a simple web link. No app installation required for viewers. 3. Declare is now available in 16 languages, making it accessible to users around the world. Thanks for supporting Declare!

records.name: SolarTuner
records.tagline: Plan your solar system before installation
records.description: Plan smarter solar projects with SolarTuner. Explore rooftop installations, check balcony solar kits and prepare detailed solar PV plans directly from your phone. SolarTuner brings measurements, visual panel design, production estimates and project documentation together to help you understand your options before installation. Create a plan for a roof, balcony, facade, ground-mounted installation or carport.

records.name: Neutant
records.tagline: Billing, stock, accounts and a B2B marketplace in one app
records.description: Neutant is an all-in-one billing, inventory and accounting app for small businesses: 10 business types, 26 languages and the tax rules of 20+ countries. Built-in B2B marketplace and Neutant Explore to find local businesses and get quotes.

records.name: Euno
records.tagline: A journal that gives your words back to you
records.description: Euno is a personal journal for iOS and Android. You write your day; Euno replies with a short reflection that quotes your own words. Over time it shows what repeats: a weekly reflection and a portrait of you. 34 guided journals, 20 short wellbeing practices. Free to start. Not therapy, just a journal.

records.name: OmniTool Hub
records.tagline: 50+ privacy-first dev utilities running 100% client-side
records.description: Privacy-first developer suite featuring PDF editors, JSON formatters, JWT decoders, cryptography suites, and converters.

records.name: Disco Vibe
records.tagline: A music-reactive 3D nightclub in your pocket
records.description: Disco Vibe turns music into a playful 3D nightclub on iPhone, with reactive characters, lights and camera changes. For music fans and creators who want an immediate visual toy rather than a full VJ production setup.

records.name: Dot Shooter: Space Bullet Hell
records.tagline: Twin-stick bullet hell roguelite
records.description: A twin-stick bullet hell drawn like a blueprint. Four sectors, nine bosses, 13 evolutions.

records.name: BidRep
records.tagline: Find government bids that fit you. Get the bid built.
records.description: BidRep finds federal, state and local government bids that fit your business and emails them to you. Pick one and it builds the bid package: proposal written to the bid's rules and the agency's forms filled in. You price, sign and submit. Free plan.

records.name: TargetDossier
records.tagline: Cited research dossiers on any target company
records.description: Instant, cited research dossiers on public companies: financials, leadership, ownership, competitors, risks and talking points. Free to read, no signup.

records.name: Gymscle
records.tagline: Free workout tracker for iPhone and Apple Watch
records.description: A native training tracker for iPhone and Apple Watch. Build structured plans, run them at the gym, track your progress. Free, no account, no subscription.

records.name: Trylane
records.tagline: Let anyone try your software before signing up
records.description: Let anyone try your software before signing up. Each visitor gets a private, disposable workspace in your real app, with sample data and outside calls switched off.

records.name: LinguaFlow
records.tagline: Beginner French lessons with spaced-repetition review
records.description: Learn French from zero with short, structured lessons. The first course, French for English speakers (Beginner, around A1), has 10 lessons in 3 units: greetings, the verb être, numbers and time, everyday verbs, and café, shopping and directions. Interactive exercises with audio, spaced-repetition review of the words you practise, and streak/XP/accuracy tracking. Runs in any browser with no sign-up; lessons 1–3 are free. More languages are planned.

records.name: Binhop
records.tagline: Inventory app for small businesses.Scan, sell, restock
records.description: Scan barcodes with your phone, sell and receive in a tap, and see low stock before it runs out. Your whole team works on the same numbers, free. Every change can be undone. Free for 30 items.

records.name: GoodTill
records.tagline: Good till you need it.
records.description: That forgotten gift card is a dinner out. Snap any coupon, gift card, warranty or free trial and GoodTill reminds you before it expires. Free, no account, no ads. Anonymous analytics only (opt-out anytime); your wallet stays on your phone.

records.name: Cardora - Medical Flashcard
records.tagline: AI flashcards built specifically for medical students
records.description: Cardora turns your med school notes, lecture slides, and PDFs into ready-to-study flashcards in seconds. AI builds your flashcard decks automatically, so you spend your time reviewing, not typing. Built for USMLE, NCLEX, PLAB, FCPS, MBBS, NEET, AMC, and COMLEX, not a generic study app repurposed for medicine. Built specifically for medical students prepping for USMLE, NCLEX, PLAB, FCPS, COMLEX, AMC, and MBBS coursework. Not a generic study app repurposed for medicine.

records.name: Shotgun: Car Quiz for Families
records.tagline: A road-trip quiz the whole car plays out loud, phones down
records.description: Shotgun reads a question to the whole car, and everyone answers by speaking. One phone hosts, the rest join with a code, or one phone plays for everyone. Nine games, questions sized to each player's age, no account, no ads. Try it for 30 minutes.

records.name: Mapples
records.tagline: Visual builder for Expo apps, with AI and real code
records.description: Mapples: the visual canvas for your existing Expo repo. Design on a canvas, sync to real code, keep full control. Not a no-code tool. Not throwaway AI code.

records.name: Fiume
records.tagline: An AI journal where Fio and Socrates help you think
records.description: Say what's on your mind and Fiume turns it into a clean memo or journal entry. Fio, an AI with long-term memory, works through hard questions with you. Or talk it over with Socrates, Kant, Jung and other sages. iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.

records.name: YellowNex - 60+ Free Calculators for USA
records.tagline: Free GPA, Calorie, VAT USA, Age - No Signup, Instant
records.description: Problem: USA students search GPA Calculator 720K/mo, fitness lovers search Calorie 964K/mo, small businesses search VAT Sales Tax USA. All separate sites, ads, signup. Solution: YellowNex - 60+ Free Calculators in one hub. GPA 4.0 (3.57 example), CGPA to %, Calorie TDEE 2600, VAT USA CA 7.25% TX 6.25% FL 6% ($100+8%=$108, $108/1.08=$100), Discount, Age, BMI, TDEE. Who: USA students CA TX FL NY, fitness, small business. Free, no signup, instant, mobile. https://www.yellownex.com/p/all-tools.html

records.name: Groupiie
records.tagline: Find local clubs and things to do in your city
records.description: Local clubs live in scattered WhatsApp groups and Instagram pages, so finding a running group, book club or weekend trek is mostly luck. Groupiie puts them in one place. Every city has a page with real local groups by interest, upcoming events, and a "things to do this weekend" list. Organisers get a free club page, RSVPs with a waitlist and QR check-in at the door, and can claim their group's listing in two minutes. Live in 85+ Indian cities and Dubai, and it installs on your phone like an app.

records.name: Sweep On: Fluffy Bounce
records.tagline: Arcade bounce game where timing and control keep you alive.
records.description: Swing into action with Sweep On, an arcade bounce game where timing and control keep your run alive. Hold the screen to swing around the core and position yourself for the next bounce. Land on fluffy white balls, avoid dangerous spiky dark sides, and keep building your high score. Chain your bounces, collect stars, and take on increasingly challenging levels. Every run is another chance to beat your best score.

records.name: HireBand
records.tagline: Expectation Alignment Intelligence
records.description: Expectation Alignment Intelligence for hiring and retention. Detect expectation gaps before the first interview and monitor alignment throughout the collaboration. Not a job board, marketplace, recruiter or ATS.

records.name: StormWeatherEU
records.tagline: weather
records.description: StormWeatherEU is a modern weather platform focused on weather, severe weather, and weather monitoring across Europe. The platform is currently in beta and is continuously being expanded. Planned and partly available features include weather radar, forecasts, severe weather information, soundings, weather maps, and additional professional weather tools. During the beta phase, bugs may still occur and some features may not yet be fully available. Feedback, suggestions, and bug reports etc help us

records.name: FontGrid
records.tagline: Preview your own text across dozens of fonts at once
records.description: Type your own text and see it across dozens of fonts in a smart grid. Save favorites in unlimited folders, then compare side by side and pair up to 5 fonts. Free to start, Pro free for 7 days.

records.name: EasySay
records.tagline: Private offline dictation for Mac, Windows and iPhone
records.description: Speak, and the text appears in any app with punctuation. Recognition runs on your device, so your voice never leaves it. Also transcribes videos and folders, records calls with a summary, and translates.

records.name: QR Gen Me
records.tagline: Turn images and GIFs into artistic QR codes
records.description: Create artistic QR codes with your own photos or animated GIF backgrounds. Add a link or text, choose a background, and download PNG or GIF without signing up. Try original examples for event screens, digital invitations and portfolios. Test your finished QR on real phones before sharing.

records.name: Milo
records.tagline: Photograph a page, keep the sentence you loved
records.description: Milo is a reading journal for the lines that stop you, on iPhone and Android. Photograph a page, the text is read on your phone, and the quote is kept with its book and page. Tap a word to learn what it means there, or mail a quote to a stranger.

records.name: ShopTalk
records.tagline: The Business Context Platform
records.description: ShopTalk is a Business Context Platform that connects customer interactions to the right teams, delivering instant context across Sales, Support, and Operations.

records.name: iamai — Your AI Twin
records.tagline: Your voice, your memories, your AI twin
records.description: Your personal AI twin: remembers your notes, goals and people, answers in your cloned voice, grows with every conversation. Voice cloning is free. Plus a speaking avatar and Ether, a network of digital twins.

records.name: cookimg
records.tagline: image > recipe; recipe dietary remixer; smart pantry
records.description: Turn any food photo, pantry shelf, or craving into Authentic, One-Pot, and Meal-Prep recipes. Remix any dish for Gluten-Free, Keto, Nut-Free, Vegan, or custom spice/salt levels. Easily manage your recipe-driven shopping list.

records.name: Purr Notes
records.tagline: Markdown, tasks & local AI
records.description: Purr lives on the edge of your screen. Click the edge or press ⌘⇧N and your notes slide in. Capture from any app with ⌘⇧Space, write in Markdown, record voice notes and ask Frida, a private AI on your Mac. Free up to 20 notes. Pro is a one-time purchase.

records.name: DeskyPaw
records.tagline: A tiny 3D pet that lives on your mac or windows desktop
records.description: DeskyPaw puts a fully animated 3D pet on your Mac desktop or Windows desktop. 16 pets, a built-in focus timer (your pet naps while you work and barks at break time), no account, no tracking. Free 7-day trial, then a one-time purchase.

records.name: DMC Pilot
records.tagline: One system for MICE and incentive DMCs, quote to wheels-up
records.description: Built for destination management companies running incentive trips, meetings and events. Build proposals from real costs, turn the yes into the program, track the group's flights and transfers, and run the day from a phone app.

records.name: DocSolved
records.tagline: Documents in. Predictable data out. Ready in seconds.
records.description: Turn documents and images into reliable, structured data with AI - at up to 10× lower cost than enterprise alternatives. Extract, verify, and review data from invoices, receipts, e-invoices, and more. Organize everything with workspaces and dossiers, collaborate and share securely with one click, protect sensitive information with automatic data masking. Connect AI agents instantly via MCP, integrate any system through APIs and webhooks, or export results in your preferred format.

records.name: EntropyGrid
records.tagline: Rebuilt: 30-second trace, star cards, public receipts
records.description: AI can imitate our voices, faces and writing. When we can't tell "is this a human?", trust breaks down. The internet will need a proof that a live human is behind an action, owned by no one company. Your body already proves you're alive: trace on your phone for 30 seconds, and your hand makes tiny movements you can't control. We test if they can become random numbers and a proof of human. New: 30-second trace, star cards, receipts timestamped on Bitcoin. Not verified yet. Goal: 2,000 people.

records.name: AI Weather
records.tagline: First release: a daily AI weather briefing, spoken aloud
records.description: Stay ahead of the weather — with a personal AI voice that briefs you every day. AI Weather gives you accurate, real-time forecasts plus something no other weather app does: a natural, spoken daily briefing generated by AI, tailored to your exact location and conditions. Tap one button and hear a short, natural-language summary of today's weather — temperature, conditions, rain chances, air quality, and UV — read aloud, not just displayed.

records.name: ClauseGuard
records.tagline: AI-powered AI-powered contract audit and compliance checker
records.description: ClauseGuard helps founders, legal teams, and freelancers catch hidden risks in contracts instantly. Manually reviewing complex agreements, NDAs, and SaaS contracts is slow, costly, and prone to oversight. ClauseGuard automates this with smart AI analysis. Key Features: - Automated Playbooks: Instant compliance scans for GDPR, NDAs, and SaaS terms. - Smart Diffs & Redlines: Easily track changes and risky clauses. - Secure Workspaces: Built with robust cloud security.

records.name: Ad-Skipy
records.tagline: Skip video ads on YouTube and beyond, automatically
records.description: Ad-Skipy is a free Chrome extension that automatically skips and blocks video ads, so you get straight to the content. Unlike most skippers built only for YouTube, it also works on Dailymotion and other video sites, and the list keeps growing. No setup: install it once and it runs quietly in the background. Lightweight, no account, no personal data collected.

records.name: Crochet Graph Maker
records.tagline: Turn any image into a crochet graph pattern you can stitch
records.description: Crochet Graph Maker helps crafters convert photos and artwork into stitch charts for tapestry crochet and graphghans. Paint or import an image, adjust colors and grid size, get yarn estimates and written instructions, then export SVG, PNG, or PDF — free, no signup.

records.name: VideoToURL
records.tagline: Video to URL Converter
records.description: Convert any video to a URL in seconds. Upload MP4, MOV, WebM and get a shareable link — free, no sign-up, no watermark, with permanent links on paid plans.

records.name: Lumni
records.tagline: Catch AI agent failures that look like success
records.description: Your AI agent says the refund was issued, but the API call failed. Lumni detects silent failures in agent traces, pinpoints what went wrong, and helps teams investigate, replay incidents, and prevent regressions. Start by pasting a trace—no SDK required.

records.name: Gourmetmiles
records.tagline: Portable Macroscale with free Gourmetmiles nutrition app
records.description: A free nutrition app for iPhone and Android that pairs with the Macroscale, a patented, display-free pocket food scale. Weigh to 0.1 g under your plate, log 30 nutrients, share diet records with your dietitian. No subscription, no ads.

records.name: MiningLucky
records.tagline: Build a solo mining rack. Watch every share in one room.
records.description: Choose BTC or BCH mining power and time for each machine, then track hashrate, accepted shares and session progress in one place. Explore the interactive demo before buying a session. Demo data is simulated. Paid solo mining can end with no block or reward. Block fee: 0.4%.

records.name: DealAlign
records.tagline: Increase partner sales. Improve partner profitability.
records.description: DealAlign is an AI-powered revenue and commercial optimisation platform for companies selling through partners, distributors and resellers. It helps identify partner-led deal risk, clarify accountability for shared actions and understand partner profitability after attributable costs. Current stage: working MVP available for guided demonstrations using illustrative data; pre-seed with two design partners. This is not a generally available production release.

records.name: Downbit
records.tagline: Native video & audio downloader. No yt-dlp.
records.description: Native Mac, Windows & Linux app (and CLI) that downloads video and audio from the web. Paste a link or open any page in the built-in browser. Go engine from scratch — no Python, no yt-dlp, no FFmpeg. Free forever; Pro $19 once.

records.name: AudioScript 声稿
records.tagline: Offline real-time bilingual subtitles in 29+ languages
records.description: AudioScript turns whatever is playing on your computer — podcasts, videos, meetings — into live bilingual subtitles: source text plus translation, in a floating overlay. Everything runs locally, offline. Chinese and English are built in, with 29+ languages available via optional downloads (LMT-60, NLLB-200, macOS system translation) and ASR (Nemotron, Qwen3). • System audio, mic, or both • Always-on-top overlay, adjustable size, opacity, lines • Free, MIT, macOS / Windows / Linux

records.name: Verafii
records.tagline: GPS site photo reports your client can verify
records.description: GPS camera app for field teams: live site photos stamped with time and location, one-tap PDF photo reports, and a QR code your client scans to verify.

records.name: marketixpro
records.tagline: SMM in Delhi – Grow Your Business with Marketixpro
records.description: Marketixpro provides professional social media marketing services in Delhi to help businesses grow their online presence, increase brand awareness, engage target audiences, and generate quality leads. Our services include social media management, content creation, Instagram and Facebook marketing, paid advertising and performance analysis. With strategic planning, creative content, and we help startups, small businesses, and established companies achieve their digital marketing goals

records.name: TypingTeacher Typing Speed Test
records.tagline: Free Typing Speed Test
records.description: Free online typing speed test with 1, 3 and 5 minute modes, accuracy scoring, AI practice drills and a touch typing curriculum.

records.name: Heft
records.tagline: A fast workout log you can also update by chat
records.description: Heft is a flat, fast workout log for iPhone, iPad and the web, built for strength, cardio and skills like parkour and BMX. Log sets in a few taps, get next-session weight suggestions, keep a weekly streak and log workouts by chat through an AI assistant. Free, with Plus at $3.99/mo.

records.name: Araia — baby tracker
records.tagline: Araia is a baby tracker
records.description: Araia is a holistic baby tracking and parenting app for the first few years, built in India: one-tap logging of feeds, nappies, sleep, solids and medicines, the IAP, WHO or CDC vaccination schedule with reminders, WHO growth charts, milestones, doctor appointments and medical reports, co-parent sync, and an AI assistant that reads your own baby's logged history before it answers.

records.name: Sign & PDF Tools: SignKit
records.tagline: Sign, fill and manage PDFs on your phone, offline
records.description: SignKit is a PDF signer and PDF tools app for Android. Sign PDF documents with your handwritten PDF signature, merge, split, compress, convert image to PDF and PDF to JPG, all on your device. Your documents are processed on your device and never uploaded. No account, no sign-up, no cloud. Export clean files with no watermark. Sign contracts, forms and paperwork from your phone: Every tool is free with limits.

records.name: masoc
records.tagline: The new Lightroom alternative for iPhone, iPad and Mac
records.description: A pro photo and video editor built from scratch for Apple devices. RAW, Apple Log video, film looks, Lightroom preset import and AI masks that run on your device. Type what you want and Smart Edit sets the sliders. Free to try, then subscribe or buy once.

records.name: Fluxo: Gravity Runner
records.tagline: A one-tap neon gravity runner with one shared daily course
records.description: Fluxo is a one-tap neon gravity runner. Tap to reverse gravity and ride the floor or ceiling past spikes, barrier walls, crushing pistons and laser gates, with a new sector rule every 8 points. Three near-miss dodges ignite FEVER for double gold. The Daily Challenge is one fixed course per day, identical for every player on the same version. There are Classic, Hyper and Zen modes, plus 18 pixel-art pilots to unlock.

records.name: Glint Label Registry
records.tagline: Run your label end to end, with verifiable certificates
records.description: Label Registry, by Glint, gives label owners one workspace for their standard, their registers and public verification. Publish versioned requirements, receive applications with self-assessment and evidence, assign an independent verifier, record a reasoned decision and issue numbered certificates. Anyone can check them on a public register, a QR code or a badge. Software only: not a certifier or law firm.

records.name: Shoalcheck
records.tagline: Read-only Kubernetes audit engine for drains, upgrades, CI
records.description: Read-only Kubernetes audit that runs from your laptop. One reading lists reliability, security and cost findings from 89 detection rules and 15 stack analyzers, each tied to its object. Preflight answers a change before you make it: which node won't drain, what a lost zone strands, what blocks the next upgrade. CI/CD gate with SARIF, findings filed in Jira or Linear. Free preflight; CLI and desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux.

records.name: FluenTech
records.tagline: Free grammar, vocab & exam guides in 14 languages
records.description: FluenTech is a free set of language guides for Turkish, Russian, French, German, Italian, Spanish and English: grammar lessons with tables and examples, themed word lists with audio and quizzes, guides to 70+ exams (DELF, DELE, Goethe, TYS…) and bilingual book samples. Every page is available in 14 languages, from Arabic to Korean. Our apps add spaced repetition and progress tracking.

records.name: Looped In
records.tagline: Drop in a flyer. Get events, tasks and notes back.
records.description: Drop in a flyer, a screenshot, a pasted message or a sentence said out loud, and Cue finds the events, tasks and notes for you to confirm. Your first Loop is free, and anyone you invite uses the Loops you share with them free.

records.name: Abracadraw
records.tagline: Videos that draw your photos, characters and text by hand
records.description: Abracadraw turns your photos, characters and text into videos that draw themselves. A hand sketches them in pencil, a chisel carves them in stone, a spray can paints them as graffiti or a swarm of light builds them. It runs in your browser and exports MP4 up to 4K.

records.name: CutoutGrid
records.tagline: Transparent PNGs to consistent white-square JPGs offline
records.description: CutoutGrid turns already-transparent static PNGs into a consistent set of centered white-square JPGs. Unify the visible subject size, choose 800/1200/1600/2000 px outputs, and export a ZIP with processing reports. Low-resolution images are not enlarged. Runs locally in desktop Chrome. Free demo: 3 images. Full: 50 images per batch, $19 once. Background removal is not included; opaque PNGs and JPG inputs are unsupported.

records.name: DueNudge
records.tagline: Auto-chase clients for freelancers
records.description: Freelancers lose thousands of dollars every year because they are too polite or too busy to chase clients for overdue payments. Sending manual "just checking in" emails is awkward and time-consuming. DueNudge solves this. Add a client, set what you're waiting for (payment, approval, file, or reply), and it automatically sends polite reminders on your behalf. You get a dashboard showing who owes you. Free for your first 5 clients.

records.name: Tessera
records.tagline: A daily word puzzle where every letter is already there
records.description: Tessera is now a free app on iPhone and Android. Every letter is already on the board, just in the wrong place: swap two tiles until every row spells a word, in as few moves as you can. Since the web launch in May it has grown Tessera Chain, a ladder of levels with stars and timed bonus rounds; daily leaderboards and private leagues; 20 themes, each free to try; Hard mode on 5x5; and Spanish. One puzzle a day, the same for everyone.

records.name: Hello Socials
records.tagline: Schedule your social media posts for less
records.description: Plan and publish your posts on Instagram, LinkedIn, X, Pinterest, Facebook, Threads and TikTok from one editorial calendar. Analytics with CSV export, API and webhooks, team roles and approvals, data hosted in the EU. From €9.90/month per channel, 7-day free trial. Built by Hello Factory.

records.name: Pulseboard
records.tagline: Weekly marketing dashboards that tell you what to fix
records.description: Pulseboard reads your marketing data and tells you what to fix. Real example: it caught our Facebook posts with links getting 14 impressions vs 184 without, a 13x gap. The fix was one line. Every channel, one page, every Monday. From $149/mo per dashboard.

records.name: PostInk
records.tagline: The AI writer for X that throws away AI-sounding writing
records.description: PostInk is a Chrome extension that writes X posts, replies and threads in your voice, then checks every draft and sets aside anything that reads like AI. Only what you approve gets scheduled. - Three reply drafts right inside x.com, scored and filtered - Fill your week: save your topics, get a draft for every open slot - Bring your own model. Your keys stay in your browser - No account needed. 7 days free, then $3.99 once

records.name: GBPguru
records.tagline: Free Google Business Profile score for local businesses
records.description: Free audit tool that scores your Google Business Profile across 10 key factors and shows what to fix to turn Google Maps visibility into more calls and leads. Built for US local service businesses. No signup or credit card needed.

records.name: KWS Trends
records.tagline: Check keyword search volume and website traffic
records.description: Free keyword search volume, trends, KD and CPC with Google Ads Keyword Planner data, plus monthly visits, traffic sources and ranking keywords for any domain.

records.name: EraseAI Firewall
records.tagline: Stop secrets and PII before you hit Send in Public LLMs
records.description: A browser firewall for AI chats. EraseAI checks your prompts in ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini for API keys, passwords, card numbers and personal data before you send. Free on-device, no account; Personal adds redaction and attachment scanning.

records.name: Tuneshot
records.tagline: Make YouTube videos in your browser, nothing uploaded
records.description: Turn tracks into YouTube videos, cut and merge clips by timestamp, and publish straight to your channel. Free, no watermark, and your files never leave your device.

records.name: Prompter
records.tagline: clearer prompts, one shortcut, your claude code or codex
records.description: Prompter turns the Claude Code or Codex setup you already have into a one-shortcut prompt rewriter for your Mac. Type a rough draft in any app, hit your shortcut, and a clearer prompt replaces your text in place. Polish keeps meaning, code, links and @mentions untouched. Expand builds a full brief and leaves [blanks] instead of guessing. No API key - rewrites run through your existing Claude Code or Codex login and count against your plan's normal limits. Free + open source (MIT), macOS 14+.

records.name: ZS Bundles
records.tagline: Bundles, quantity breaks and Black Friday deals for Shopify
records.description: ZS Bundles puts Black Friday-ready offers on Shopify product pages: quantity breaks (buy 2, save 20%), buy X get Y, mix & match boxes, gift boxes and a bulk order table. Shopify applies the price at checkout, so there are no discount codes to leak, and bundles use the products you already have. Every bundle type is on the free plan, and we set up your first two bundles for free.

records.name: modern.css
records.tagline: Old CSS side by side with modern CSS
records.description: 120 old CSS patterns next to the modern CSS that replaces them, a CSS audit for any site and an email when new CSS is safe to use. Free.

records.name: WoW Forever Leveling Calculator
records.tagline: See the date you hit level 60 in WoW Forever
records.description: A free calculator for WoW Forever players planning the launch. Set your current level, how many hours you play a day and your pace (first time, know the zones, speed leveler). It shows the play time you have left, the date you reach 60 and whether you will be ready for the Phase 1 raids on December 9, plus how many hours a day you would need. Based on beta leveling pace, no sign-up, and you can copy a link snippet to share it in your guild or guide.

records.name: CastPulse: Podcast Production
records.tagline: Track every podcast episode from first spark to published
records.description: CastPulse is a Mac production tracker for indie podcasters and YouTubers juggling episodes in sticky notes and spreadsheets. Follow each episode from first spark to published: visual pipeline, daily pulse, guests, show notes, files and checklists.

records.name: SnapShare
records.tagline: Take photos, send instantly, skip the camera roll
records.description: SnapShare is an iPhone camera app for photos you only need to send, not keep. Take a photo, and SnapShare copies it and opens your chosen app or the share sheet. Just paste and send. No more screenshots, receipts, or random photos cluttering your camera roll. Free to start, with optional Pro features for a one-time purchase. No subscription.

records.name: SpeedGlance
records.tagline: GPS speed and road limits without starting navigation
records.description: SpeedGlance shows GPS speed and available road limits without starting navigation. Use a digital or analog speedometer, or keep your speed above your map with Pro Mini Overlay. Correct a road limit and SpeedGlance remembers it on your phone for that stretch and direction. Available on Google Play in the US, Canada, and Australia.

records.name: Streaks Strokes
records.tagline: A rowing app for iPhone
records.description: A rowing app for iPhone and Apple Watch that connects to your Concept2 PM5 over Bluetooth. It shows pace, stroke rate, power and heart-rate zones live, saves every row to Apple Health and keeps a streak of the days you row.

records.name: .shush
records.tagline: Sleep & Focus Noise Machine
records.description: New features now available - Together - Drift off together, even when you're apart. One person starts the night, the other joins. Your own sound, your own volume, the same timer — and the same bedtime. CarPlay - something for the parent. Stop the engine not the sleep Shush the noise. Every noise app fights your room. Shush works with it. Quieter sound. Deeper sleep — all synthesized, never looped Smart sleep timer with gentle fade.

records.name: WooMe
records.tagline: One app for every pet family: care, family, photos & more
records.description: WooMe is the one-stop app for every pet family, across all your pet chores and socials. Record by pet: each pet gets its own health records, reminders and history. Share the load: invite family and caregivers. Many people, many pets, one shared view of who did what. Private first: most features run on your device. When the cloud is needed, privacy comes first. Social, the fun part: photo album organizing and gallery palettes. Coming soon: Shop and Services, rolling in step by step.

records.name: Klip
records.tagline: Dynamic QR codes and short links, billed in M-PESA
records.description: Klip is short-link and QR-code infrastructure built for African businesses. Pay in M-PESA with prices in KES, not a foreign card. Free links never expire, so a printed code never dies. Dynamic QR codes re-point to a new page without a reprint, and scan analytics break down by country, device and referrer.

records.name: Social Gym
records.tagline: Gym workout tracker with XP, streaks and duels with friends
records.description: Social Gym turns lifting into a game so it is easier to keep showing up. Every workout earns XP: level up, protect your weekly streak, challenge friends to weekly 1v1 duels and race for the monthly podium. Find community routines by goal, level and equipment, see the muscles they train on a 3D body, log every set with automatic PRs, and ask an on-device AI coach. Free, with an optional one-time upgrade (no subscription). iPhone and iPad, 7 languages.

records.name: Devpply Tech Resume Builder
records.tagline: Resume Builder and ATS-Readiness Checker for Developers
records.description: Build a single-column resume for technical roles, check it against a job description, and export a PDF. Start with 10 download credits and 20 AI credits.

records.name: Instagram Caption Generator
records.tagline: Generate engaging Instagram captions for photos,
records.description: Use this free Instagram caption generator to turn your notes into 3 captions with a strong first line, up to 5 hashtags, and a live post preview.

records.name: Disklumo
records.tagline: The Mac cleaner that shows every file first
records.description: A native Mac cleaner for Apple Silicon. Clear caches, logs, Xcode and AI tool files and System Data; find duplicates and old files; uninstall and update apps; map your disk. Every item is shown before it moves, and it goes to the Trash.

records.name: RésAtout
records.tagline: Booking and ticketing for tourism and leisure businesses
records.description: A booking site in the business's own brand, for rental companies, activities, castles and museums: live calendar, day, half day, hour or session, card and French ANCV holiday vouchers, card-hold deposits, online contract, counter sales and ticket scanning. No commission on sales. Available in French.

records.name: Dream Interpreter Wheel
records.tagline: Explore possible meanings behind your dreams
records.description: An interactive dream interpretation tool that helps you explore possible meanings behind dream symbols. Discover interpretations, reflect on your experiences, and explore the fascinating world of dreams through a simple, engaging wheel.

records.name: Poly Duo
