records.description: Free test management with hosted MCP for any AI client — Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, VS Code, or your own agents. Agentic Test Management on Advanced: triage CI failures, draft-PR self-heal, automations, and webhooks.

records.name: Hookdeck Inspect
records.tagline: Free webhook tester for you and your agent
records.description: Test and debug webhooks with Hookdeck Inspect. Get a live URL you and your agent can use, plus mock webhooks for 500+ providers. It's free, no account or setup required.

records.name: Flockbay
records.tagline: Free AI game maker built on Godot
records.description: Flockbay is a free AI game maker built on Godot: an agent in the official Godot editor that writes GDScript and scenes, then playtests them. It runs the game, sends input events, reads the debugger and captures the viewport. Your game stays a plain Godot 4 project on disk. Start on free hosted AI, or bring your own Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, API key or MCP agent, or a local model on your GPU (Windows). Paid plans add Steam page drafts, trailers and devlogs. Godot 4.6+ on Windows, macOS, Linux.

records.name: Wavefunction
records.tagline: A minimal, open-source coding agent for your Mac
records.description: Coding agents keep turning into super apps. Wavefunction goes the other way: a minimal desktop app built for coding. Keep chatting while it works on several tasks in parallel. Use your ChatGPT subscription, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter or a local model. Computer use runs on its own desktop, not yours. Free and open source.

records.name: asklog
records.tagline: Give your coding agents a boss. Answer it from your phone.
records.description: Tell Chief one job. It splits it into tasks and starts Claude Code or Codex workers, each in its own copy of your repo, then brings you the decisions. Watch and answer from your phone, across your computers. Nothing merges without your authorization.

records.name: LifeVal
records.tagline: OpenAI's benchmark for everyday life tasks with AI
records.description: LifeVal is OpenAI's new eval for the everyday tasks people most want help with, like finding childcare, budgeting, ordering groceries and government services. OpenAI says it used LifeVal for a year to push ChatGPT toward real agent work.

records.name: Scrawl
records.tagline: Show your AI agent the problem with a visual frame
records.description: Scrawl records your screen, voice, clicks and drawings, then packs them into one compact capture you paste into your AI coding agent. Press ⌥⇧S, talk, click and draw. Frames are taken only when something happens, speech is transcribed on your Mac, and each frame is cropped to where you worked. Works with iPhone mirroring and ScrawlKit for iOS apps. Open source (MIT). macOS 15+, Apple silicon.

records.name: Beaquaro Studio
records.tagline: Write once, post everywhere. Your link in bio, too.
records.description: Write in your own voice, post to your platforms, reply to comments, and share one link page with your portfolio, projects and bookable video calls. Free to start. Built by one person in the UK for creators who are tired of ten tabs.

records.name: Beamfy
records.tagline: AI vision assistant for blind people, live in 74 languages
records.description: Beamfy is an AI vision assistant for blind and low-vision people. Tap once and it describes what is in front of you as you walk, speaking only what changes, hazards first, until you stop it. It reads printed text aloud, tells you what you are holding, finds a place by voice with walking directions, and SOS texts your emergency contact with your location. Built for VoiceOver and TalkBack, in 74 languages. Photos are not stored. Free to start on iPhone and Android.

records.name: SUN Web & API
records.tagline: Turn prompts and PDFs into audio, on the web or via API
records.description: Meet the new SUN web experience and SUN API. Turn a prompt or PDF into podcasts, audio courses, audiobooks, stories, meditations, or music. Choose your voices, language, and length, explore public audio, and build audio generation into your own apps with the API.

records.name: Peji
records.tagline: An AI chat with a real browser you control
records.description: The browser on your iPhone finishes the task. Ask for a price comparison, a flight, a PDF summary: Peji opens WebKit tabs, reads them, clicks and types, and keeps going until the job is done, with every step in the chat. It stops and waits for your tap before it sends, buys, pays or deletes. Chats, files and dictation stay on the phone. Answers that are a price list or a schedule come back as a table or a chart with the source links. Free on the App Store; Pro adds usage.

records.name: NEXUPIRA
records.tagline: AI teammates that hand back finished work
records.description: Hire an AI team, not another chat box. Every WhatsApp customer message gets a reply drafted from your own documents, Rex prepares quotes as PDFs, Docu turns receipts and statements into Excel, and Nova keeps your calendar. Set routines that run on schedule. Connect Google Workspace and Notion free; Slack, GitHub and Linear on Pro. Work with your AI team from ChatGPT or Claude (Pro). You approve what goes out. Free to start, Pro US$15/mo.

records.name: Oreja de Van Gogh
records.tagline: pause Apple Music while ChatGPT speaks
records.description: A macOS menu bar app that pauses or lowers Apple Music while ChatGPT speaks, then returns it at the level and position you chose.

records.name: Prism
records.tagline: Cursor for hardware engineering
records.description: Prism is the AI platform for hardware engineering. CAD, physics solvers, 3D viewers, coding, and reporting together in one place, all driven by agents. Go from ideas to validated design effortlessly. Free to try on Windows, Mac and Linux.

records.name: EaseIn Health
records.tagline: Track GLP-1 doses, symptoms and daily habits in one app
records.description: Most GLP-1 apps stop at the dose. The hard part is everything in between: getting enough protein and water, handling nausea, keeping a routine. EaseIn tracks the whole journey & not just the injection: - Dose log with injection site rotation - Symptom log for nausea, fatigue & more - One daily card for protein, water, fibre, activity & sleep - Weekly Wrapped, a recap of your week - Dedicated Health coach for questions between appointments

records.name: Corvo
records.tagline: A mailbox that tidies itself as mail arrives
records.description: A new mailbox, not a layer over Gmail. Sign-in codes sit on the row with Copy, then archive themselves. Give each site its own address and pause it if it leaks. Trackers removed, scams called out. Agents draft under grants; nothing leaves without you.

records.name: Remote Gaze
records.tagline: Your Mac on your iPad and iPhone with no in-between server
records.description: Remote Gaze puts your whole Mac on your iPad or iPhone at Retina resolution, up to 120fps, with touch, trackpad, keyboard and Apple Pencil. Nothing passes through anyone else's server: devices connect directly, end to end encrypted, with per-device keys in the Secure Enclave and Face ID gating. Gaze Host, the free Mac companion, gives a headless Mac mini a display of its own.

records.name: LidCommit
records.tagline: Auto-commit when you close your laptop lid
records.description: Never lose progress when you leave your desk. LidCommit is an autonomous Rust daemon with a sleek dark-mode desktop GUI that detects when your laptop lid closes, summarizes your diffs using Gemini, Ollama, or OpenAI, and pushes safely to GitHub with built-in secret scanning.

records.name: Calendarly
records.tagline: Your calendar and tasks, right on your iPhone Lock Screen
records.description: Calendarly draws your calendar, reminders, Todoist tasks, notes and countdowns onto the iPhone Lock Screen wallpaper, and redraws it automatically through a Shortcuts automation.

records.name: Testifly
records.tagline: Autonomous AI QA. Zero prompting. Zero maintenance.
records.description: CTOs and founders with small teams and no time or resources to test and maintain. Connect your web app and Testifly does the rest. Discovers flows, writes tests, self-heals, explains failures with video. Zero prompting. Zero maintenance. 30-day free trial.

records.name: VinSage
records.tagline: Free used-car check in Chrome's side panel, US & CA
records.description: VinSage sits beside any used-car listing in Chrome and shows NHTSA and Transport Canada recalls, crash ratings, owner complaints, fuel cost and a 0–100 deal score, plus a negotiation pack. Core checks are free. No account, no ads, no analytics.

records.name: Videco
records.tagline: Turn every video into a content campaign with AI
records.description: Videco is an AI content studio and video hosting workspace for marketing teams. Find standout moments in demos and webinars, create branded short-form clips, and host, embed, and measure video in one place.

records.name: BreakTimer.com
records.tagline: Boost Your Productivity: Free Online Pomodoro & Task Tracker
records.description: This isn’t just a Pomodoro timer—it’s a fully customizable focus toolkit. Choose between classic intervals or natural flowtime mode to work at your own pace. Track your tasks, customize your workspace with unique characters and backgrounds, and stay motivated with gentle, encouraging micro-prompts that keep you moving forward without the burnout.

records.name: morphic
records.tagline: morphic: SPX and ES Levels With Odds, Before the Open
records.description: Every morning before the open, morphic reads the options book and maps the session ahead: key SPX and ES levels, the odds on each, in plain English. morphic publishes a pre-market map for SPX and ES traders built from that day's options prices and crowd positioning. The map shows where the close is likely to land, which price levels matter and why

records.name: stopping.work
records.tagline: Plan your UK retirement with pensions, ISAs, savings
records.description: Find out when you could retire, how much you can afford to spend, and how to make your savings last. Plan your retirement with your pensions, ISAs and investments in one place. Simulate different withdrawal orders to find the most tax advantageous strategy, and track it all over time to stay on plan. No trackers, no data brokers, no paywalls.

records.name: HoldTalk
records.tagline: Hold fn, speak, and the text appears in any Mac app
records.description: HoldTalk is dictation for the Mac without a subscription. Hold the fn key, speak, and the text appears at the cursor in any app. Transcription runs on your Mac with Apple's speech engine, with a personal dictionary and a searchable history. 7 days of Pro free, then 2,000 free words a week or Pro once for 19 EUR during the launch.

records.name: Dayclipse: Sun & Moon Tracker
records.tagline: Golden Hour, Sunrise & AR
records.description: Track the Sun. Follow the Moon. Plan your perfect moment outdoors. Dayclipse is an offline sun and moon tracker that makes it easy to explore sunrise, sunset, golden hour, blue hour, moon phases and the changing sky. Whether you're planning landscape photography, a sunset walk, a sunrise hike or a night under the stars, see where the Sun and Moon will be and when important sky events happen.

records.name: ZeroCrew
records.tagline: The AI agents founders run their business on
records.description: ZeroCrew sets up AI agents that run your business and keeps them up to date. Get it done for you, starting at $1,000 a month, or browse the AI agents and tools ZeroCrew researched for every job and do it yourself. ZeroCrew AI Ltd also builds apps for the App Store: Flags Tax, Schengen Calculator, Visited Countries, GOAT To Do, and GOAT Habits.

records.name: HNMovies
records.tagline: 2,280+ films & docs distilled from 20 years of Hacker News
records.description: HNMovies distills 49.3M Hacker News comments (2007–present) into a ranked screening room of 2,281 feature films and standalone documentaries. Filters out technical collisions (Solaris, Threads, Primer) and meme one-liners, with an obscurity slider for hidden gems (<60k IMDb votes), 20-year mention curves, verbatim HN threads, and an open Hugging Face dataset updated weekly.

records.name: Settle
records.tagline: Voice Estimate & Invoice App for Contractors
records.description: Settle is an iPhone app for solo contractors. You describe a job out loud, Settle writes a priced estimate using your own prices, you text it from your own phone, and your customer approves or pays from a link. Payments go straight to your own Stripe account, and Settle never holds your money.

records.name: Bien
records.tagline: A calm social network that keeps you close to your people
records.description: Bien is a calm, voice-first social app for your inner circle. No AI slop. No brainrot. No ads (ever). No concept of followers. Chronological. Instead of likes, you reach out privately with your voice. Social networks today provide much more entertainment than social connection. On Instagram, you only see stuff from accounts you follow ~7% of the time. The rest is a combination of interesting entertainment content, influencers, and ad-slop. This is the endgame of the advertising business model.

records.name: Cartsaver
records.tagline: Confirm cash on delivery orders on WhatsApp before shipping
records.description: Cartsaver by Xtnd sends every cash on delivery order a WhatsApp or SMS message, and the customer confirms it with one tap. Orders nobody confirms can be flagged as high risk or cancelled after a wait you choose. You can also verify the phone number before the order, with a pre-checkout pop-up or Fast Checkout, a one-page COD order form. The same WhatsApp chat then carries order updates, cart recovery, cross-sells, reviews, auto-replies and campaigns, through the official WhatsApp Business API.

records.name: Toby Carvery Menu and Prices
records.tagline: Toby Carvery Price Calculator 2026: Estimate Your Bill
records.description: Estimate your Toby Carvery bill with our free price calculator: choose the day, add carveries, kids, extras and drinks, and see a total and discount estimate

records.name: QuickDraw
records.tagline: Turn your trackpad into a magic wand 🪄
records.description: Draw a letter with your track pad and open apps magically. Simply hold the Option Key (⌥), Draw & Boom: apps, websites, files, Shortcuts and snippets, all summoned in a stroke.

records.name: Brief - Executive Intelligence
records.tagline: Ensure what gets decided, gets done
records.description: Brief is the Executive Intelligence platform. It tracks every decision you make and every commitment your team makes back, and catches what's slipping before the deadline does, so you walk into every conversation prepared.

records.name: AYO for Restaurants
records.tagline: Free restaurant websites built from your Square menu
records.description: Connect Square and AYO builds your restaurant a free website from your real menu, prices and hours, kept in sync, plus a free directory listing. Add pickup online ordering ($99/mo) or Text to order ($79/mo) whenever you're ready.

records.name: Deburr
records.tagline: AS9102 first article inspection software for job shops
records.description: Deburr turns a customer drawing into a signed AS9102 first article inspection report. The AI balloons every dimension, tolerance, feature control frame and note, and flags what it isn't sure about with a plain reason. Paste CMM output or tell the copilot a reading: pass and fail show on the drawing, and an out-of-cal gauge blocks sign-off. A preparer and an approver sign Forms 1, 2 and 3. $249/mo for the whole team, no per-seat fees. Free ballooner, no signup needed.

records.name: Image Converter & Compressor
records.tagline: Convert & compress images in Chrome, 100% private
records.description: Free Chrome extension to convert JPG, PNG & WebP and compress images in one click. Batch process files, tune quality, and download smaller images instantly. Runs locally in your browser: no uploads, no sign-up.

records.name: KitSlate
records.tagline: Gear, call sheets, quotes, invoices and footage in oe place
records.description: KitSlate runs a production from the first enquiry tothe paid invoice. Build the gear list from your invetory and price the job from it. Send call sheets eac person confirms on their phone. Quote, invoice and ake payment with the same lines. Crew send receipts y photo or by forwarding the email, and the receipt ands on the job. Send rushes up to 1 TB: clients pla camera files in the browser, hear every track, commnt at the exact frame and read the transcript. Free lan, nothing to install.

records.name: RepoMemory
records.tagline: Shared project memory for AI coding agents
records.description: A ledger of what your project decided, learned the hard way and forbade, plus a task queue, that Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and any MCP client read before they act and add to as they work. Agents stop repeating reverted changes, and a new session starts where the last one stopped.

records.name: Content Studio
records.tagline: AI Video Studio for Your Agent
records.description: A downloadable AI video studio for your own AI agent: a video engine, 43 editable templates, edit styles for your own recordings, six agent skills, local voice and subtitles, music and sound. Make explainers, product demos, reels, thumbnails and posts, in your own brand and design system.

records.name: Chrono Matrix
records.tagline: Habit and productivity Tracker
records.description: Chrono Matrix is a luxury monochrome productivity journal and habit matrix. It visualizes your daily discipline with a 1% compounding trajectory curve, logs circadian sleep and naps, and uses an AI Disciplinary Tribunal to hold you accountable when streaks break. 100% free, private, and offline-first.

records.name: BRCKS Chat
records.tagline: The chat app for building sites. Nothing gets lost.
records.description: Every job gets its own chat for crews, subs and clients, with snags, bookings, video meetings and a client portal built in. Photos become snags, messages become a record. Subs and clients are free. Built by builders, for UK sites.

records.name: TimeCubby
records.tagline: Free calendars, date calculators & group scheduling
records.description: Print a holiday calendar, find a meeting time across cities, or calculate a deadline around days off. TimeCubby brings country and regional calendars, time-zone tools and date calculators together with group availability polls, timers and countdowns. Poll your group for a one-time event or a weekly or monthly meeting. Free in your browser, with no account required.

records.name: crew bot
records.tagline: An AI crew that works your apps, servers and computer
records.description: Crew bot is an AI crew that does the work. Hand a job to the Lead: specialists work your email, browser, apps, servers and even your computer at the same time, a skeptic checks what they find, and anything that sends, changes or spends waits for your OK. Free to start, no card needed.

records.name: WorthVehicle AI
records.tagline: AI valuation for used vehicles, with a quick-sale price
records.description: Upload a few photos or fill in the details and AI values your used car, van or motorbike in about a minute: a quick-sale price, a recommended price and a top price, with the reasoning behind each. First full report free.

records.name: Nive: White Noise, Sleep Sound
records.tagline: Sleep sounds that fade out instead of waking you up
records.description: nive is a calm place made of sound. Layer up to 6 of 60+ seamless sounds (rain, forest, ocean, fire, brown noise) into your own mix and place each one left, right or all around you. Sleep Mode fades it gently to silence over 30 min to 8 h instead of cutting off, so the stop doesn't wake you. Chromecast any sound or mix to a speaker or TV, or just ask Alexa. Plus guided wind-down breathing, offline downloads, and no data collected.

records.name: SuperClonica
records.tagline: Probably the cheapest speech API
records.description: SuperClonica probably is the cheapest speech API: $5/month for up to 216 hours of audio, 10–200× less than Google, OpenAI or ElevenLabs. 230+ voices, each speaking 31 languages in the same voice, streamed with the first sound in about 0.3 s. Every catalog voice works without buying it, even on the free key. Built for voice bots and AI agents, with an MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code.

records.name: Devtoolry
records.tagline: Compilers, formatters, PDF & image tools, all in-browser
records.description: 120 free dev tools that run 100% in your browser. Nothing leaves your device. ⚡ Compilers: Python, C, C++, Go, JS, TS, PHP, Ruby, R, SQL 🛠 Dev: formatters, validators, diff checker, regex, JWT 🔄 Converters: JSON ↔ CSV/XML/YAML, JSON to TS/Go/Rust, cURL to code 🔑 Generators: passwords, UUIDs, hashes, QR codes, test data 🕒 Time: time zone & Unix timestamp tools 🖼 Image: AI background remover, compress, resize, crop 📄 PDF: merge, compress, split, watermark No sign-up. No uploads.

records.name: AI, Sorted
records.tagline: Plain-English AI guides, tools and ready-made templates
records.description: Makes AI usable for people who don't have time for jargon — plain-English guides, free browser tools and ready-made prompt packs that turn "how do I actually use AI?" into "sorted." • Free tools: pick the right AI, spot AI-written text • Plain-English guides to get real results, no hype • Ready-made prompts and templates for trades, tutors and small businesses Built for everyday people, self-employed pros and small teams who want the outcome, not a course.

records.name: Wordtide
records.tagline: Build words on one endless board shared by everyone
records.description: A free word game on one infinite board shared by everyone. Build words off everyone else's, claim territory, light lighthouses in the World Dictionary, play the Daily Seven or a 100-puzzle Solo Journey, and let ages 3 and up learn first words with Little Tide. Free to play, no pay-to-win; no ads or tracking for kids.

records.name: Grau
records.tagline: BJJ training journal: log classes, track belt and stripes
records.description: A jiu-jitsu journal for Android. Log a class in 30 seconds (gi or no-gi, rolls, intensity, submissions), follow your belt and stripes with a goal for the next stripe and IBJJF minimum times, keep a 120+ technique notebook, and run a round timer that rings with the screen locked. Offline, no sign-up, no ads. On Google Play in Brazil now, more countries next.

records.name: Brink
records.tagline: Turn your MacBook trackpad's edges into controls
records.description: Brink is a free macOS menu bar app that turns your trackpad's edges into controls. Slide the right edge for volume, the left for brightness, the top for keyboard light. Swipe the bottom to skip, double-tap the corner to mute. Native HUD, haptic ticks.

records.name: Custodia Labs
records.tagline: No agent enters without your permission.
records.description: Today anyone can rent powerful AI by the hour and launch an agent against your business. Who decides which agent enters, what it touches and what it takes? CUSTODIA LABS is the guard: ALLOW / BLOCK / CHALLENGE / LIMIT / OBSTRUCT, fail-closed, with a log. If something fails, it closes, it does not open. Verified proof: engine p95 5.8 ms, 72/72 tests, Ed25519 signing. Revenue and customers: not published / to be confirmed by the owner. CTA: Ask for information and book a 20-minute meeting.

records.name: Emagia Corporation
records.tagline: Emagia – Accounts Receivable Automation Software
records.description: Emagia is an enterprise accounts receivable automation platform that streamlines credit management, collections, cash application, deductions, and payment processing. Using automation, analytics, and Agentic AI, it helps finance teams reduce manual work, improve cash flow visibility, track outstanding invoices, and manage customer payments. Emagia also supports enterprise ERP integrations, including SAP, Oracle, and Microsoft Dynamics, to improve the overall Order-to-Cash process.

records.name: Vitál
records.tagline: AI nutrition, fitness & cycle coach in one app
records.description: Vitál brings photo meal estimates, adaptive meal and workout plans, home/gym training, and cycle tracking into one calm dashboard on iPhone and Android. Built solo by Mahdi. Snap a meal for estimated calories and macros (always labeled as estimates). An in-app coach adapts plans over time. Wellness tools only—not medical advice. Start with a 7-day free trial, then €16.99/month or €139.99/year. Cancel anytime in App Store or Google Play. Download: vitalapp.net/get

records.name: OrderLens
records.tagline: Profit Tracker for Indian Sellers
records.description: OrderLens helps Indian marketplace sellers understand what they actually earn. Sync Meesho orders, payments, returns and claims directly from the Supplier Panel using our Chrome extension — no marketplace password or OTP required. Track payouts, reconcile payments, understand SKU-level profitability and investigate return/RTO losses. Also includes 14 free seller tools and profit calculators for Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra and Snapdeal. Free to use, with no monthly order cap

records.name: Referral Codes Canada
records.tagline: Referral Codes & Signup Bonuses in Canada
records.description: Directory of Canadian referral offers, Compare rewards and eligibility, Find signup codes and links, Explains sharing rules, Community-driven content

records.name: Keysuit
records.tagline: Typing sounds, local stats and gentle breaks for your Mac
records.description: Give everyday typing a new sound. Keysuit is a Mac menu bar app with 10 sound themes, local keystroke stats, an activity calendar and gentle break reminders. Preview the sounds in your browser, then try the free public beta for macOS 13+. No account or internet connection is needed in the app, and typed characters aren't recorded. The beta is not yet Apple-notarized.

records.name: Foresight AI
records.tagline: Website strategy platform for marketers and agencies
records.description: Know what to fix, in which order, and why. Foresight is an always-on website strategist for teams who own websites but aren’t website specialists. A free audit scores your site across 10 strategy dimensions. Connect GA4, Search Console, CRM and add sales calls to get an improvement roadmap, a new sitemap and an editable brand strategy. The platform tracks every change and reports weekly on how your site performs. Powered by AI, built on learnings from 300+ enterprise projects by Flow Ninja.

records.name: Vaultseer
records.tagline: Predict prices, win prizes from interest, keep your deposit
records.description: Vaultseer is a no-loss prediction game on Polygon. Deposit USDT, which earns interest in Aave, forecast crypto prices or sports events, and the interest funds the prizes. Your deposit stays yours and can be withdrawn any time. Beta, not audited.

records.name: Gift Happiness Wishlist
records.tagline: Free wishlists from any store — no signup needed
records.description: Create a wishlist in minutes, add gifts from any online store, and share one simple link with friends and family. Guests can privately reserve gifts, helping avoid duplicates while keeping the surprise intact.

records.name: minibuildai
records.tagline: Small apps with real databases, live the same day.
records.description: Most AI builders hand you a pretty front end. minibuildai gives the app its own database and a live URL, so what you describe is something real people can use today. No subscription — prepaid credits that never expire, a small app costs a few cents, and your first two hosted apps are free. Nothing is held hostage: one download gives you the source, the live database rows as SQL and your secrets, or you redeploy the whole app into your own Cloudflare account. Small and medium apps, on purpose.

records.name: Crossendor
records.tagline: Ecommerce AI ad arbitrage: winning ads, empty markets
records.description: Drop in any winning ad: image recognition finds the same product across 8 markets, shows who already sells it, and where nobody does yet. Plus daily-rated winning ads, top product keywords, brands scaling ads with shop traffic, and TikTok winners.

records.name: Yalivox
records.tagline: Free ATS resume checker and entry-level remote jobs
records.description: Check your resume against any job description for free, with no sign-up. Yalivox shows your match score, the keywords you're missing and formatting that trips up applicant tracking systems. It also lists entry-level remote jobs and internships taken straight from company career pages (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and more), refreshed every 6 hours, so you always apply on the employer's own site.

records.name: PowerShips
records.tagline: Where battleships meets powers!
records.description: Battleships with classes. Pick a class with an active ability and a passive, place your fleet and play a friend from a link or find an opponent online. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: FeedbackOS
records.tagline: Turn customer feedback into action
records.description: FeedbackOS turns customer feedback into fixes. It reads your reviews, support tickets, surveys and WhatsApp messages, finds the problems that keep coming up, and ranks them by frequency, severity, growth and business impact. Each priority goes to the right team as a task with an owner, due date and success metric. After a fix ships, FeedbackOS compares complaint rates before and after, so you know it worked. Built for D2C brands, SaaS teams and growing startups. Free to start.

records.name: Caltunes
records.tagline: Every song you play in Apple Music, saved on a calendar
records.description: Apple Music's Recently Played only keeps your last few songs, so the track you loved last Tuesday is gone by Friday. Caltunes saves every song you play in Apple Music on a calendar. Open any day, see what played and play it again. Import years of history from Apple's privacy export, save albums and playlists, and get a music report every month. For anyone on Apple Music who's ever lost a song. On iPhone, iPad and Mac.

records.name: Paint Pics
records.tagline: See real paint colors on your own home before you buy
records.description: Upload a photo of your room or house and see it repainted in real colors from Benjamin Moore, Sherwin-Williams, Behr and 7 more brands (17,000+ paint and stain shades). Pick the surfaces (walls, trim, cabinets, siding, brick, doors), compare before and after side by side, find colors by description or from any photo, and share a color plan with your painter. Free account; repaints are pay-as-you-go, no subscription.

records.name: MentionsAPI
records.tagline: AI brand visibility across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini & more
records.description: MentionsAPI is a developer API for AI brand-visibility and GEO. One call returns brand mentions, rank, sentiment, and citations across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity, plus Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, and Bing Copilot, each with position, context, and cited URLs. OpenAPI 3.1, Bearer auth, free tier, and a hosted MCP server.

records.name: Easyrobin
records.tagline: โปรแกรมรวมแชท LINE OA ขายในแชท ตรวจสลิปอัตโนมัติ
records.description: คุยกับลูกค้าทุกช่องทาง ปิดการขายในแชท ตรวจยอดโอนให้อัตโนมัติ และให้ทีมกับ AI ช่วยกันดูแล ใช้ได้หลายภาษา พร้อมโตไปทุกตลาด

records.name: Goal Pilot AI
records.tagline: Turn big goals into daily tasks with AI roadmaps & habits
records.description: Goal Pilot AI breaks long-term goals/objectives into smart roadmaps, daily micro-tasks, and trackable habits. Stay accountable, build momentum, and bridge the gap between ambition and daily action. records.name: LoveyDear

records.description: Make a digital wedding or engagement invitation in minutes: an envelope that opens on the phone, ceremonies with maps, music and RSVP tracking, all in one WhatsApp link. Also surprise pages for birthdays and anniversaries. Free to preview.

records.name: AEGIS

records.description: Scan agent skills and settings, investigate alerts, and pause or stop a selected process. Apply policies to selected actions through configured command-line and MCP routes. Windows-first, MIT-licensed desktop security app. Public beta.

records.name: Sovereign
records.tagline: Generate client proposals and optimize resumes instantly
records.description: Sovereign helps freelancers and agencies build professional proposals and optimize resumes to win more clients. Generate tailored pitch documents, analyze job requirements, and manage applications seamlessly from a single workspace.

records.name: Stancz
records.tagline: Plan dance formations in 2D and 3D, synced to music
records.description: A choreography app for dance teachers and choreographers. Place dancers on a stage drawn to scale, chain formations and watch every transition animate in 2D, in 3D or from the audience, synced to your music. Share the choreography with your group. Runs in the browser on PC and Mac, and on iPhone, iPad and Android, in 25 languages. Free plan: 3 choreographies with 4 formations each.

records.name: PrepQuest
records.tagline: Swipe flashcards for JS, React & system design interviews
records.description: PrepQuest is a swipe-based flashcard app for tech interview prep. Revise JavaScript, React and system design questions in four-minute sessions: swipe right for true, left for false, up if you don't know. Guessing scores zero, levels unlock at 80% accuracy instead of points, and anything you miss comes back through spaced repetition (tomorrow, in 3 days, in a week). Free on Android.

records.name: Nexa Agora
records.tagline: One workspace for your AI agents, assistants and models
records.description: Nexa Agora is an agentic workspace where people, native agents and agents you create work together. Connect Claude Code, ChatGPT, Antigravity, Hermes and other MCP-compatible tools to read, write and work on shared projects. Bring the AI subscriptions you already use, your own API keys, or LLMs running on your computer, servers or data center through Nexa Bridge. Shared knowledge, permissions and human approvals keep the work coordinated and accountable.

records.name: Orbit.me
records.tagline: Your email and chats, organized around your life
records.description: Orbit.me connects to Gmail, Outlook, WhatsApp, Google Messages and your calendars, then groups everything into Orbits: family, work, the kitchen renovation. Each Topic shows where things stand and what needs you. Free on web, iOS and Android.

records.name: Pelle Pelle Bruiser Plush Jacket
records.tagline: Bold black leather streetwear with a soft plush lining
records.description: Premium black leather jacket with a soft plush lining, stand-up collar and front zip. Sizes 2XS-4XL for men and women, with custom sizing available. Ships worldwide. Built for fall and winter streetwear.

records.name: FedoLinux
records.tagline: Practical Fedora guides, from setup to troubleshooting
records.description: Fedolinux is an independent, bilingual guide to Fedora Linux. Follow practical tutorials for installation, DNF5, upgrades, SELinux, Podman, server setup, and troubleshooting—with verification steps and links to upstream sources.

records.name: Porro
records.tagline: Client site monitoring and updates for agency care plans
records.description: Uptime, SSL, security advisories, end-of-life versions and update pull requests for every client site on your care plans, ranked so what needs you is always on top. Free, read-only connectors for Laravel, Filament, Statamic and Craft.

records.name: Vapor
records.tagline: a journal that asks for one word a day
records.description: Write one word a day. Over time the words become a calendar, a cloud and a forecast of your inner weather. Private by design: no accounts, no cloud, and encrypted backup is free. Free on iPhone and Android, built solo in Melbourne. Premium, with a free trial, adds a monthly recap film and printables.

records.name: FamWord
records.tagline: Rotating family words that stop voice-clone scams
records.description: AI can clone a loved one's voice in 3 seconds. FamWord gives your family rotating secret words a clone can never know. The FBI recommends a family code word — but a static word can be overheard. FamWord's words change every 30 seconds: nothing to steal, nothing to memorize. Set up with a QR code, no accounts. On a suspicious call, ask for the three words. Match — it's them. No match — hang up. Works offline, no tracking. One purchase covers the whole family. Free for 7 days.

records.name: LifeMaxing
records.tagline: A gamified app for fitness, wellness & productivity.
records.description: LifeMaxing is a daily self-improvement gamified app for iPhone and Android. Instead of keeping a workout app, a calorie app, a habit tracker, a sleep app, and a focus timer, you use one system and turn on only the parts you want. Those parts cover body, mind, habits, and learning: workouts, meals, sleep, habits, deep work, meditation, journaling, affirmations, and book summaries. Home shows the day's tasks, a consistency score, and streaks.

records.name: Cresca
records.tagline: An AI email marketing platform with transactional email
records.description: Cresca is an AI email marketing and transactional email platform. Describe a campaign in plain words and its AI agent designs an on-brand, editable email, and a REST API sends your app's password resets, receipts and verification codes. Both send from your own domain.

records.name: AppMagpie - App Price Tracker
records.tagline: Never miss a paid Android app going free or on sale
records.description: Paid apps go free on Google Play every day, but only for a few hours. AppMagpie spots them for you. AppMagpie collects paid Android apps and games that are temporarily free or discounted, checks every deal on Google Play, and shows you what's worth grabbing before the offer ends. Install an app while it's free and it stays in your library for good. Premium apps and games you can install now without paying. Each one shows its usual price, its rating and how long the offer lasts.

records.name: Sunclock
records.tagline: Plan sunrise, sunset, golden hour and blue hour
records.description: Sunclock is a free browser-based daylight and photography planner. Check sunrise, sunset, twilight and golden/blue hour windows, explore the Sun's position, choose a preparation buffer, and export a calendar plan. Five US cities have reviewed detail pages; the planner also offers coordinate input. Times are astronomical estimates for a level horizon, not weather forecasts.

records.name: JS Index
records.tagline: The JavaScript ecosystem, indexed!
records.description: Its a javascript tools directory where you can submit your tools and can get them indexed to get dofollow backlinks to your site.

records.name: BannerMagic
records.tagline: Festival & birthday banners in 14 Indian languages
records.description: Every Indian celebration gets a banner: birthdays, Diwali, jayanti, shop openings. Most banner apps are English-only, stamp a watermark, or charge ₹299/month. BannerMagic gives you ready-made headlines in 14 Indian languages, 40+ designs from Indian folk art (Warli, Kolam, Madhubani), your photo and name, and sizes for WhatsApp Status, Instagram and flex printing. Free, no watermark, no sign-up. The app has no internet permission, so your photos never leave the phone.

records.name: Quake MCS Listener
records.tagline: Earthquake alerts with a countdown, for any automation
records.description: Open-source bridge that turns earthquake alerts into a webhook for anything you run: smart homes, apps, servers, sirens. It tells you how hard it will shake where you are and how many seconds you have. Official EEW, USGS, EMSC, your own sensor and Google's Android alerts (no Android device needed).

records.name: Lume IQ
records.tagline: A free IQ test with an honest score and no subscription
records.description: A 30-question reasoning test (matrices, number series, mental rotation, odd-one-out) with questions generated on the spot, so nobody can memorize answers. Your score is free and comes with its margin of error, scored with item response theory. No subscription, no locked results.

records.name: AtlasForgeX
records.tagline: New companies from the business register, every day
records.description: Atlas is a desktop app for B2B prospecting. It reads official business registers every day, puts the newest companies first and finds each one's website, phone, email and decision-maker. Buying signals and a built-in CRM are included. One fixed price for 92 countries: €300/month, no credits.

records.name: SteepSlate
records.tagline: Private offline tea session and inventory ledger
records.description: Record tea lots, inventory, teaware snapshots, infusion sessions, timers, and append-only corrections. SteepSlate works fully offline with factual history, CSV exports, and checksum-verified backups—without brewing or health advice.

records.name: Irum
records.tagline: Your name in Korean calligraphy
records.description: Type your name and Irum writes it in Hangul, the Korean alphabet, as brush calligraphy. Hear how it sounds, pick from 4 brush styles, and download the image for free. Need it for a T-shirt or a print? The Full Pack gives you high-res and vector files for personal and commercial use.

records.name: The Observatory
records.tagline: A new word every day, three challenges and your own galaxy
records.description: Every day a new word waits in the viewfinder. Learn what it means, how it's used and where it comes from, then master it with three quick challenges: Comprehension, Usage and Mastery. Each word becomes a star in your own galaxy, grouped into constellations by category. Review brings words back right before you'd forget them, and 3D companions react to every answer. Streaks, widgets and a weekly leaderboard with friends. The whole app works in English and Spanish. Free on iPhone and Android.

records.name: PrepperApp for Android, Web & Outdoors
records.tagline: How many days could your home last? Now on Android and web
records.description: PrepperApp started iPhone-only. Now it runs everywhere: a full Android app and a web dashboard at prepperapp.net, synced across your household. New: an Outdoor section that records hikes with routes, photos and water sources on offline maps, plus family "I'm safe" check-ins with a shared emergency plan and meeting points. Still at the core: one honest number of how many days your water and food last. Free to start, Pro is a one-time purchase.

records.name: EmojiDig
records.tagline: Emoji search that understands slang and typos
records.description: EmojiDig is a free emoji search and copy site. Type what you mean, including slang and typos ("dead", "side eye", "sparkel"), and copy any emoji in one tap, with your skin tone. It covers every emoji through Emoji 18.0, checks live which new emoji your device can display, and has meaning guides for popular emoji. There's also a free MCP server so AI assistants can search emoji too. No ads, no sign-up.

records.name: Japan 100
records.tagline: 100 things you can only do in Japan, sealed with a stamp
records.description: Japan 100 is a quest board for your trip: 100 uniquely Japanese things to actually do, from slurping ramen properly to climbing Mt. Fuji. Pick a quest, do it for real, snap a photo, and it's sealed with a red hanko stamp. Every quest includes an etiquette tip so you get it right the first time. Commons, rares, and eight gold legendaries. Export your board as a share card. No account, no servers: photos stay on your phone. First 30 quests free; one purchase unlocks all 100, no subscription.

records.name: PulseCast
records.tagline: Your channel live 24/7 from the cloud. No PC, no OBS.
records.description: Upload a video once, paste your stream key, and PulseCast keeps your channel live 24/7 from the cloud: lofi radios, ambient channels, countdowns, reruns. Automatic reconnect when YouTube or Twitch drops the stream (including Twitch's 48-hour cut). Works from a phone. Free plan with no time limit, 48-hour trial with 1080p and 3 channels; Starter $19/mo, Pro $29/mo for 3 channels in 1080p.

records.name: spectraNET
records.tagline: See which apps use your internet, as a living 3D city
records.description: Free per-app network monitor for macOS, Windows and Linux. Every app is a tower in a 3D city (or a tile on a 2D map): see who it talks to, how much, what kind of traffic, and get alerts when it contacts a known malicious server. Pause or block any app. Everything is measured locally, nothing is decrypted or uploaded. The snet command line is open source.

records.name: Healti
records.tagline: Calorie, Nutrition & Workout Tracking Made Simple
records.description: Track calories, protein, macros and workouts in one simple app. Free health calculators, high protein recipes and practical nutrition guides.

records.name: Cardlake
records.tagline: Save from Claude and ChatGPT into one feed
records.description: One feed for reminders, learnings, bookmarks and work follow-ups. Connect Claude or ChatGPT and save things just by asking, then find them again from any chat. Free to start, with an open-source edition to self-host.

records.name: Dino Strike
records.tagline: The lost Flash brawler, back from the dead and playable now
records.description: Remember Dino Strike? The forgotten arcade classic returns, rebuilt for the modern web. Jump into action, take on dangerous enemies, face returning bosses, and fight your way through the campaign without installing a Flash plugin. With multiple difficulty modes, enhanced boss encounters, a six-slot save system, and Photo Mode, this restoration brings a childhood favourite back to life while adding new ways to play. Flash may be gone, but the dinosaurs aren't.

records.name: SOFTYX Clothing

records.description: SOFTYX Clothing is Bangladesh's premier luxury clothing brand, founded and owned by Samir Qureshi. Official Website: https://softyx.shop. Contact/WhatsApp: +8801725198663. Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/softyxwear.

records.name: Mominly

records.description: Mominly is an Islamic companion for iPhone and Android. Check location-based prayer times, set prayer reminders, find Qibla direction, read daily duas and keep track of dhikr with Tasbih. It also brings together the Islamic calendar and Islamic learning content. The website offers city prayer times and duas with Arabic text, transliteration and meanings.

records.name: Simple Sums

records.description: UK money tools for the decisions that matter. Enter your figures, see the numbers, understand what they mean. One payment, no subscription. Your figures stay on your device.

records.name: Flyer

records.name: cocurate

records.description: Paste a link or describe a craving. cocurate pulls out the real recipe, wires every ingredient and timer into the steps, and helps two people cook it together.

records.name: CoverNice
records.tagline: AI book covers that pass KDP print checks
records.description: Describe your book, get five editable cover directions, then export a print-ready PDF with real spine width, bleed and safe area for your trim size and page count. Free spine calculator, no signup.

records.name: Party Games Registry
records.tagline: Find the best online party game for your group
records.description: Browse 50+ online party games. Filter by free, no signup required, mobile-friendly, and player count. Find the perfect game for your group in seconds.

records.name: Shikhar Public School
records.tagline: Shikhar Public School
records.description: शिखर पब्लिक स्कूल: संस्कार, जिज्ञासा और आत्मविश्वास पर आधारित आनंदमय शिक्षा, जो हर बच्चे को नेतृत्व की ओर बढ़ाती है।

records.name: GreenClaimFix
records.tagline: Find and fix green claims the EU now bans in your shop
records.description: GreenClaimFix checks every product page of an online shop for green claims that EU Directive 2024/825 (EmpCo) bans since 27 September 2026, and writes a compliant rewrite for each one using only facts already in your text.

records.name: StopScribe
records.tagline: Exact steps + official links to cancel any subscription
records.description: StopScribe: free How to cancel guides (exact steps + official links) for 50 services, a free audit checklist, and an in-browser tracker. Optional $12 one-time Pro adds renewal reminders — no bank login.

records.name: FlipStack
records.tagline: Guided two-sided printing for printers without auto-duplex
records.description: Many home and office printers can't print on both sides by themselves. FlipStack fixes that from the macOS menu bar: drop a file, print the fronts, flip the stack once when asked, and the backs come out in the right order. No shuffling, no guesswork, half the paper. PDFs, photos (bit-exact, never recompressed), and Word/text documents. Real driver options for paper, quality, and page ranges. Fully local, Open source, MIT.

records.name: Multistream Chat
records.tagline: TikTok live chat into one side panel
records.description: See every chat while you multistream. It merges Twitch, Kick and TikTok LIVE chat into one browser side panel: type your channel names and press Start. No account, no OBS setup. • TikTok included, which most multistream chat tools leave out • Real 7TV, BTTV and FFZ emotes, badges, sub/gift/donation alerts • Show only events, or only mods/VIPs/subs, when chat gets fast • A "1st" tag on new chatters, so nobody gets missed • Read-only and private: never posts, sends no data anywhere

records.name: Keytracx
records.tagline: Gerencie suas keys e licenças de acesso em um só lugar.
records.description: Com o Keytracx, você pode gerar, validar e gerenciar keys de acesso, administrar contas de clientes e controlar os períodos de licença em um único painel. Simplifique o gerenciamento dos seus produtos digitais!

records.name: Imogen Pro
records.tagline: The AI studio for images and video on Mac
records.description: The newest image and video models in one Mac studio, with your own API keys. No credits, no markup. 100 free generations to start.

records.name: SpoofLens
records.tagline: See how websites see your browser
records.description: Free check of whether a browser fingerprint adds up: system vs GPU vs fonts, time zone vs IP, headers vs JavaScript, automation traces. No signup. Free beta account: check links with a consent screen and a matrix showing which profiles are one device.

records.name: Loopli
records.tagline: An AI agent that runs your Instagram and Facebook
records.description: Loopli is an AI agent that plans, writes and designs your Instagram and Facebook posts, drafts replies to comments and DMs, and sets up Meta ads. A person approves every post, reply and ad before it goes out. From $49/month, 14-day free trial.

records.name: Nuvavio
records.tagline: Create vertical videos with AI scripts, visuals, voiceovers
records.description: Create vertical videos with AI scripts, visuals, voiceovers and captions.

records.name: Stereogram Studio
records.tagline: Make, Decode & Animate Hidden 3D Pictures on iPad & iPhone
records.description: Stereogram Studio makes hidden 3D pictures on iPad and iPhone: single-image stereograms built from a shape, a 3D model, a depth map, a LiDAR photo, a drawing or a line of text. Decode any stereogram back to its relief, animate the hidden shape into video, build seamless patterns and print a book. Making and decoding are free; one purchase unlocks exports.

records.name: ZipTier
records.tagline: AI Sales Rep for Marketing Websites
records.description: ZipTier is an AI Sales Rep for marketing websites - engages visitors, tracks activity across pages, qualifies leads, books meetings, and syncs leads to HubSpot.

records.name: Zvena Tables
records.tagline: Turn spreadsheets into clear, up-to-date reports
records.description: Zvena Tables turns CSV and Excel files into clear reports with charts, totals and comparisons. Update your data without rebuilding the report, check the rows behind any number, and share it with clients. Try it free without signing up.

records.name: SKDULER
records.tagline: Best Weekly Planner App & Daily Routine Tracker
records.description: SKDULER is a weekly planner, daily routine tracker and focus timer in one. Plan the week, execute with a timer, review what actually happened.

records.name: FoldCrypt
records.tagline: Password-protect selected folders on shared Mac drives
records.description: FoldCrypt puts a password on selected folders on the SSDs, hard drives and RAIDs you share, leaving everything else open. Core protection is free forever; Pro adds Smart Folders.

records.name: HYDRATION HERO
records.tagline: The water tracker that turns hydration into a game.
records.description: Hydration Hero is a water tracker and reminder app for iPhone and Apple Watch that turns drinking water into a game. Build a full-body avatar who cheers when you drink water, gets jittery on coffee and goes a bit wobbly after wine. Smart goals count caffeine and alcohol differently from water, so your daily target adjusts to what you've actually had. You can set reminders at your own intervals, keep streaks, earn badges and add custom drinks.

records.name: EzguBozor
records.tagline: AI shopping consultant — don’t search, just ask
records.description: Stop scrolling catalogs — just ask. EzguBozor is an AI shopping consultant: describe what you need in your own words and language, by text or voice, and it finds matching products from real local stores, explains why each one fits, and connects you directly with the seller on Telegram, Instagram or by phone. No middleman, no checkout — just the right product and the right store. Available on the web and in Telegram.

records.name: VibeFix
records.tagline: We fix it in your code, then re-check it live
records.description: Tell us the one thing broken in your live app. A free check confirms it. For $79, an AI agent finds the cause, fixes it in your code and re-checks your live app. If we can't complete your re-check, you get your money back.

records.name: FluentPro
records.tagline: Workplace English for engineers and tech teams
records.description: FluentPro helps engineers practise the English they use at work: stand-ups, code reviews, technical discussions, incident updates and interviews. Each lesson shows the casual way to say something next to a clear, professional version, plus the situation it fits. Lesson quizzes, flashcards and Smart Review (spaced repetition driven by your own recall ratings) make it stick. Free to start on Android; Pro unlocks premium modules.

records.name: Acoustic Panel Accessories
records.tagline: Acoustic wall setup with our acoustic panel accessories.
records.description: Complete your acoustic wall setup with our acoustic panel accessories, including trims and fittings that help create neat edges and a clean, finished look.

records.name: Reudex
records.tagline: Local document base, AI assistant, Auto tag, file index
records.description: Reudex is a local-first knowledge base for macOS. Tag everything. Find anything. Your library stays on your Mac.

records.name: Septalingua
records.tagline: Read, translate and understand with AI and offline tools
records.description: Septalingua is a privacy-first reader for books, documents and images in 20+ formats. Translate and explore grammar with AI, use online medical references and downloadable offline dictionaries. Recognize printed text locally with OCR, edit PDFs and images, and protect backups with on-device encryption. Available as a web app and PWA in 9 interface languages. All implemented features are free during public alpha, subject to technical and usage limits.

records.name: UUMit
records.tagline: Every Agent gets an address.
records.description: Your laptop runs a web app, two MCP servers, and a Postgres instance. A teammate's Agent needs to call one — right now that means a tunnel, a firewall rule, or a VPS. UUMit gives each machine a stable address over an outbound-only connection. Nothing listens inbound, and the address stays with you across machines. Unlike a tunnel: permissions are per-service and per-caller, revocation is instant, and each machine's card is signed so callers can verify it's you.

records.name: Mull
records.tagline: Learn anything, and actually remember it
records.description: Type anything you want to understand. Mull writes a short lesson as you read, with diagrams, quizzes and sources, and a tutor beside the text. Then it turns the key ideas into cards and brings them back right before you’d forget them.

records.name: Atrix AI
records.tagline: The all-in-one AI workspace for small teams
records.description: Atrix AI is an all-in-one workspace for teams of 2 to 15: projects, docs, team chat, a calendar with booking links, a CRM pipeline, hiring and HR in one place. An AI agent turns a brief into requirements and planned work. Claude, ChatGPT, Codex and Cursor can work inside it through an MCP server that can never do more than the person who connected it. Web, Mac, Windows, Linux and iPhone.

records.name: Spyrochat
records.tagline: Private Messaging, Sharing & Fair Monetization
records.description: End-to-end encrypted messaging and sharing, with fair monetization for creators. Chat securely, post media, and get paid.

records.name: Hunchlet
records.tagline: Two intuition games — trust your eye, score your instinct
records.description: Hunchlet is built on one idea: your instincts are confidently wrong, and it's fun to find out by how much. 🥣 Spill Point — guess the exact tilt angle where a vessel first spills. Most people are off by 20–30°. 🧩 Thread It — rotate an irregular shape to fit it through a gap. Clean fit scores 100. Five rounds each, scored out of 100 — 500 a day per game. No account, no install, about two minutes. New sets daily. Score to beat from our first day: 378 on Spill Point.

records.name: ShipToWP
records.tagline: Turn an AI-built site into an editable WordPress theme
records.description: ShipToWP converts a site built with an AI builder or plain HTML into a real, installable WordPress theme. Paste your site URL or upload the exported files and preview the converted theme for free, then download the installablezip. The output is a native WordPress theme, not an iframe or locked builder embed: you own the markup, can edit it with Gutenberg, or import it into Elementor. Built for freelancers, founders and agencies. One-time unlock per theme, no recurring fee.

records.name: Masroofak
records.tagline: Arabic-first budget app for Egyptian salaries
records.description: Masroofak is a free, Arabic-first web app for salaries and household budgets in Egypt. It shows how much you can spend today until payday, logs expenses by tap, voice or a pasted bank SMS (no bank connection) and comes with free 2026 EGP calculators.

records.name: Crowdboard
records.tagline: The team game show for work, on any TV
records.description: Crowdboard turns any TV into a game-show board for work. Two teams guess the most popular survey answers, and everyone buzzes in from their own phone, with no app to install. Play ready-made questions or your own team's answers. Free for up to 6 phones.

records.name: Pick & Clear: Photo Cleaner
records.tagline: Clear your photo clutter, one swipe at a time
records.description: Keep the photos you love. Clear the clutter. Pick & Clear helps you review photos, screenshots and saved images on your device. Browse all accessible images, just screenshots, or a specific album. Start on-device analysis for your chosen scope. Images and recognized text are not uploaded to a developer-operated server. Text search requires analysis, and similar-image suggestions should be reviewed manually.

records.name: Sonicaura Studio
records.tagline: MCP Server for AI Agents & AI Audio Workspaces for Creators
records.description: Sonicaura is the ultimate AI audio suite. It features Workspaces for creators and a hosted MCP Server for AI agents. Runs 100% locally for total privacy and zero waits. Creator Workspaces: Tailored for Podcasters, Cover Artists, Producers, Instrument Learners: • Stem Splitting, Vocal Extraction • Noise Reduction, Chord Extraction and MIDI Export MCP Server for Agents: • Connect Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, VS Code, or custom agents. • Automate splitting, cleaning, and exporting hands-free.

records.name: AgentaOS Stores
records.tagline: Your online store, built for you. Paid from 190+ countries
records.description: No website? We build your store for e-books, templates, courses and services: landing page, up to 5 product pages and checkout, live in 5 working days. Buyers pay by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay from 190+ countries and get their files by email. We are the official seller, handle the tax and invoices, and pay you out where you live, even where Stripe doesn't work. Runs on AgentaOS, the merchant of record for AI agents.

records.name: MZERK: Neon Arcade Racing
records.tagline: Neon tunnel racing for iOS, with free browser play
records.description: Race through neon tunnels in MZERK. The iPhone/iPad game has 100 courses and a 60-second Arcade mode. Play offline with no ads or in-app purchases for $0.99 US, one-time. Try the browser version free at mzerk.xyz.

records.name: ARR Creative Center
records.tagline: All-in-one 3D print toolkit for Windows
records.description: ARR Creative Center is a Windows app for 3D printing, made in Germany. Create lithophanes, lamps, stands and filament pictures, check printability, and export STL, 3MF or OBJ files. Built in German, fully translated to English. Early Access starts 3 November 2026.

records.name: Enni
records.tagline: Context for coding agents
records.description: Your coding agent is ready to build. Is the task? Enni checks GitHub issues and PRs for missing details, unresolved decisions, and blockers before work starts. It brings together context from GitHub and connected Linear and Slack workspaces, shows the evidence behind each finding, and suggests what to address next. Use it with Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Actions. Try Enni on a public GitHub issue for free, no account needed!

records.name: minimax-music-plus
records.tagline: Python CLI for MiniMax music workflows
records.description: Python CLI for MiniMax music workflows: distinct web-session/API-key routes, structured-caption LLM pass, composer and cover flows. Stdlib implementation; provider credentials and credits required for live use. Written in Python. Open source, MIT. Source, docs and issue tracker: https://gitlab.com/ameobius-ai/minimax-music-plus

records.name: NFC Wizard
records.tagline: Read, write and automate NFC tags from your phone
records.description: Turn your phone into a powerful NFC toolkit. Read, write, lock and program multiple NFC tags with NFC Wizard. Create tags from QR codes, reuse templates, build digital business cards for Apple and Google Wallet, and keep your data backed up to the cloud. Designed for creators, businesses, developers and anyone exploring contactless technology.

records.name: padit
records.tagline: Wie viel von deinem Gehalt wirklich übrig ist
records.description: Die App rechnet von Gehalt zu Gehalt: was fix abgeht, was du wirklich frei hast, wie viel pro Tag. Ohne Konto, ohne Cloud, ohne Werbung.

records.name: Flashcade
records.tagline: Study flashcards by playing games
records.description: AI generates flashcards and lets you study them through interactive games.

records.name: WayR
records.tagline: Get your personalized route
records.description: Personalized routes for better days away.

records.name: CutNest
records.tagline: Cut List Optimiser for Sheet, Bar & Tube
records.description: Cut list optimisation software for sheet metal fabricators, joiners, timber merchants and anyone cutting sheet, bar or tube. Minimise waste, order less, and turn the cut list into a customer quote.
